tei:div.tei:p: de yang ya wa krī zhes pa lta bu mtha'i gsal byed brtsegs pa min pa/ gra ma ṇī lta bu dang*/ ya wa lū lta bu ī ū ring po'i mtha' can las pha rol tu dbyangs byung ba la ni/ ī ni ya dang*/ ū ni wa dag tu 'gyur bas/ au la/ gra ma ṇ+yau/ ya wa lwau/ mtha'i gsal byed brtsegs na ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ bh+rū zhes pa la bha dang ra brtsegs pa yod kyang*/ byings bzhin du u wa ru bsgyur la/ s+t+rī'ang sa dang ta dang ra gsum brtsegs kyang byings bzhin du i ya ru bsgyur bas/ bh+ru wau/ s+t+ri yau/ s+t+rī dbyangs pha rol la byings dang 'dra bar nges sam zhe na/ ma nges te/ de am dang shas dag pha rol la/ der yang na ba yin pas so/ /s+t+ri yaṃ/ s+t+rīm/ s+t+ri yaḥ s+t+rīḥbyings dang mi 'dra ba'i phyogs la/ am shas dag gi dang po dbyi ba byas pa'o/ /'di rnams la dbyangs zhes pa kun la/ slob phan du rnam dbye zhes pa'i tshig zur ma byung zhing*/ dper brjod rnams ni/ au dzas sogs rnam dbye'i dbyangs dang sbyar nas mdzad da/ོ/ gnyis pa ni bha wan+ta zhes pa'i rtags 'di'i pha rol tu/ sam+bud dhi byung ba la/ wa la sogs pa'i gsal byed gsum dang*/ wa'i srog a dang bcas pa u yig gcig nyid du bsgyur nas/ bha'i a dang mtshams sbyor bas bho/ 'khor chen gyi bho bho yang de lan gnyis su brjod pa kye kye zhes 'bod pa'o/ /'di la snga ma'i yang na 'jug pas yang na he sngon dang*/ brtsegs pa'i mtha' phyis pas he bha wan slob phan las/ rtags smos pas/ rtags kyi khyad par yang bzung bas na bha wan+tī zhes pa'ang de dang 'dra bar bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ mi zad pa dang*/ sarba nā ma'i rtags rnams la/ mi shes smad dang mi nus dang*/ /de bzhin thung dang rjes su brtse/ /ming la yang ni mkhas rnams kyis/ /aka ka'i rkyen ni rab tu sbyin/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ mi shes pa sogs kyi don can du byed na/ mtha'i dbyangs las snga mar/ aka'i rkyen dang*/

rtags gzhan la ni ka'i rkyen yang de rnams kyi don la sbyin no/ / dper na/ mthon po'i ming uts+tshais zhes pa 'di la mtho dma' mi shes pas brjod par 'dod na/ aka byin pas/ uts+tsha kaiḥ dam pa'i ming nī tsais la smad par 'dod na/ nī tsa kaiḥ dal ba'i ming sha nais zhes pa mi nus pa'i don la sha na kaiḥ bṛk+ṣa shing gi ming la thung ba'i don du bṛk+ṣa kaḥ bu'i ming pu tra la/ brtse ba'i don du pu tra kaḥ lha sbyin gyi ming de ba dāt+tā la ming gi don du de ba dat+ta kaḥ de thams cad la yang na rjes su 'jug pas uts+tshaiḥsogs kyang ngo*/ /de bzhin du thams cad dang*/ gang dang*/ khyod dang*/ bdag rnams kyi ming*/ sarbaḥ yaḥ twa yaḥ ma yaḥ rnams la mi shes pa sogs kyi don la/ ak mtha'i dbyangs las snga mar byin pas/ sarba kaḥ ya kaḥ sogs so/ /smad pa sogs la'ang grub 'bras 'dra bas tshig grogs la bltas nas rtogs par bya ba yin no/ /mi zad pa dang sarba nā ma'i mthar ka'i rkyen 'di byin pa la/ rtags bud med du byas pa'i ā yig pha rol la snga ma'i a yig ni i yig tu 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ sarba/ bishwa kā ra/ hā ra rnams la bud med la a las āp/ ā ring po 'di'i snga mar ka byin/ mdo 'dis rtags mtha'i a yig i yig tu bsgyur bas/ sarbi kā bi shwi kā kā ri kā hā ri kā zhes sogs so/ /zhes pa ming bzhi par rkang pa gnyis pa dmigs bsal gyi rkang pa bshad zin to// //gsum pa yuṣ+mad sogs gyi rkang pa la/ yuṣ+mad asmad kyi dang*/ t+yad sogs brgyad kyi dang*/ rdzogs pa dang gsal byed dang po'i lus 'gyur bshad pa'o/ /dang po la yang na ba dang*/ de min pa'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la spyir btang ba dang*/ dmigs bsal dang*/ lus 'gyur gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po la/ rnam dbye gsum gyi mang tshig la dang*/ gnyis tshig la dang*/ gcig tshig la brten pa'i lus 'gyur ro/ /

dang po ni/ 'og nas rkang pa'i dang po la min no zhes 'chad pas/ tshu rol na tshig med na mi 'gyur bas tshig las pha rol tu byung ba'i khyod dang bdag gi skad dod/ yuṣ+mata dang asmata ces pa'i rtags 'di gnyis dag ni pha rol tu rnam dbye drug pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang gnyis pa gsum gyi mang tshig ām dang bh+yas dang shas rnams byung ba la/ yuṣ+mata was dang asmata nas ces par 'gyur ro/ /de yang tshig go zhes pa/ rnam dbye dang bcas pa der 'gyur ba yin pas slar yang rnam dbye'i lus 'gyur mi dgos par tshig tu grub zin zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ drag po khyed rnams kyi mnga' bdag dang*/ thub pa nged rnams kyi mnga' bdag ces pa'i don la ām sbyar na/ ru tro waḥ pra bhuḥ mu ni naḥ pra bhūḥ yang na ṣ+mata asmata la ām thams cad las ām las su/ sāma'i ā kam/ ru tro yuṣ+mā kaṃ pra bhuḥ mu n+yasmā kaṃ pra bhuḥ de bzhin du bh+yas la/ ru tro wo/ rak+ṣa ti/ mu ni no rok+ṣa ti/ yang na bh+yas ni a bh+yama'o byas/ 'di rnams kyis rnam dbye la/ mtha' dbyi'os ta phyis pas ru tro yusma bh+yam rak+ṣa ti sogs te/ drag po khyed rnams kyi ched du srung bar byed sogs so/ /de bzhin du khyed rnams la ster zhes sogs kyi don la shas byin/ ru tro waḥ dā s+ya ti sogs/ yang na shas kyi ān mtha' dbyi ba byas pas ru tro yuṣ+mān dā s+ya ti sogs so/ /'dir yuṣ+mata dang asmata sgrub na/ yu ṣi 'tshe ba la'o/ /i brjod don no/ /a sa yod pa la'o/ /a brjod don na/ོ/ u ṇa las yu ṣi a si dag las ma di ka'o zhes pas ma di ka'i rkyen ka dang i rjes 'brel rdzogs pa la yang na 'os da tar bsgyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtags de gnyis rnam dbye de gsum gyi gnyis tshig os dang*/ bh+yām dang*/ au nyid rnams pha rol la rim pa bzhin/ wān dang nau zhes par rnam dbye dang bcas par 'gyur bas/ ru trau wān prabhuḥsogs yang na yu wa ā wa dag gnyis rjod pa rnams la 'os/

de gnyis yu wa dang ā wa ru bsgyur/ ma bsgyur ba la e nyid do zhes bcad cing os la bsgyur ba'i bya ba ma bshad pas/ rtags mtha' e dang e a yar btang bas ru tro yu wa yoḥ pra bhuḥsogs so/ /bh+yām la ru tro yu we bh+yām/ 'on kyang 'di la gsal byed dang po la ā nyid do byas na ru tro yu wā bh+yām/ da dā ti| au la am dang au'ang ām'o zhes bsgyur bas ru tro yu wāṃ/ rak+ṣa ti sogs so| |gsum pa ni/ gcig nyid la zhes pa twad mad dag dang te me gnyis ka la sbyar bas mdo gnyis dang*/ twā mā ni gnyis pa la'o zhes pa mdo gcig ste/ mdo gcig la mdo gsum mo zhes bshad pas/ don tshan gsum du byas la/ de yang yuṣ+mata asmata la 'og nas dmigs bsal med pa'i gcig tshig am dang ṭā dang ngasi/ ngi rnams pha rol la rtags nyid twad dang mad ces par 'gyur la rnam dbye am ni/ ām du 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan rnams rjes 'brel 'phyid pa ma gtogs lus 'gyur med pas/ spyir mtha' dbyi ba dang*/ ma bsgyur ba la e byas pas twām dang*/ mām/ twa yāḥ ma yā/ twa yaḥ ma yaḥ twa yi/ ma yi/ 'di rnams kun las tshig las ces pa 'jug pas/ ru tra'am/ tshangs pa la/ zhi ba zhes kyang zer bas de'i skad dod shi ba sogs sngon du dgos te/ e waṃ/ ma yā zhes pa'ang 'di'o/ /de ni dmigs bsal med pa'i gcig tshig la brten pa'o/ /rnam dbye bsgyur ba ni/ ṭā i na dang*/ ngasi āt la/ twe na dang*/ twād ces sogs so/ /da ni sngar gyi rnam dbye gsum po'i nang nas gnyis pa las gzhan gnyis po'i gcig tshig pha rol la de gnyis te dang me ru bsgyur bas/ sangs rgyas khyod dang bdag gi rje zhes pa la/ bud dhaste swā mi/ bud dho me swā mi/ lta bu ni ngas la brten pa yin la/ de yang yang na ngas la ta wa ma ma byas na bud dhaḥ ta wa swā mi sogs/ nge la bud dhaste dā s+ya ti sogs yang na nge la tu bh+yam ma h+yam bya'o/ /de gnyis gnyis pa'i gcig tshig la ni/

twā dang mā ru yang na 'gyur zhing*/ yang na rnam dbye ām du bsgyur bas/ bud dhas+t+wām rak+ṣa ti/ bud dho mām rak+ṣa ti/ 'di rigs la'ang*/ ma gsal byed la rjes su nga ro bya'o/ /dmigs bsal ni/ ji skad du bshad pa'i lugs 'gyur de rnams kyang*/ rtags de gnyis tshig bcad kyi rkang pa'i dang po la yod na bya rung ba ma yin no/ /dper na/ bla ma mchog dang thugs dbang rnams/ /bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs dang mgon/ /drag po la sogs lha chen dpal/ khyed cag rnams kyi skyabs su 'dod/ /ces pa la/ gu rūt+ta ma tsa mu nīn+t+rāḥ asmā kaṃ sha ra ṇa nā thaḥ ru trā di ma hā de wa shrī/ yuṣ+mā kaṃ sha ra ṇa kā māḥdang zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'dir slob phan las sam+bud dhi pha rol la'ang*/ sngar gyi lus 'gyur rnams mi bya bar bshad de/ 'og gi si'i bya ba'i dmigs bsal yang yin nam snyam mo/ /tshig las pha rol gyi yuṣ+mata āsmata dag tsa dang sogs pa wā dang*/ hā dang*/ a ha dang*/ e wa rnams dang sbyor ba na/ was dang nas sogs su mi 'gyur ro/ khyed rnams kyi grong khyer yang la grā mo yuṣ+mā kaṃ tsa sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ rtags de gnyis dang de gnyis kyi lus 'gyur twata dang mad ces pa 'di rnams kyi pha rol tu rtags dang rnam dbye gnyis ka lhan cig tu 'gyur ba dang*/ rnam dbye la brten nas rtags ril po 'gyur bar bshad pa rnams ma gtogs pa'i rnam dbye rnams pha rol la rtags mtha'i gsal byed rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /yuṣ+mā bh+yām/ yuṣ+mā su/ twad/ nga si/ gnyis nyid ma yin pa'i lnga pa zhes pas/ at a yig la dbyi/ twat mat/ 'di ni nga si byung rjes kyi tshig yin pas/ rtags dang gzugs mtshungs kyang don mi mtshungs par shes par bya'o/ /yuṣ+mata asmata dag gnyis brjod pa ni rnam dbye pha rol la yu ba dang ā wa zhes par 'gyur te rnam dbye dang bcas pa min gyi rtags nyid der 'gyur bas| am/ au bh+yām rnams la rtags der bsgyur/

am 'chad 'gyur de ma thag pa'i lus 'gyur byas pas/ yu wāṃ ma bsgyur ba la e byas pas yu wa yau/ gsal byed dang po la ā yu wā bh+yam/ 'di rnams la rnam dbye gnyis tshig kho na dgos pa min te/ slob phan du rtags de gnyis gnyis brjod pa dag yin gyi rnam dbye ni min te/ khyed dag 'das pa rnams zhes sogs kyi don la/ a tī yu wā bhiḥ a tī ā wā bhiḥ zhes sogs bhis kyi lus 'gyur bshad pas so// des na 'chad 'gyur gyi twaṃ a hai (haṃ)nas/ ta ba ma ma'i bar gsal kha phud pa rnams ma gtogs/ de gnyis gnyis brjod pa kun la yu ba ā wa ru bsgyur bar bshad do| |rnam dbye dang bcas pa'i lus 'gyur gcig tu bshad pa'i skabs las gzhan du/ rtags de gnyis las pha rol gyi am dang au'ang ām du bsgyur/ rtags gnyis twā mā ni gnyis pa la'o zhes dang*/ yu wa ā wa ru bsgyur ba la mtshungs 'dra byas pas twāṃ/ mām/ yu wāṃ/ ā wāṃ/ rtags de gnyis las pha rol gyi shas ni ān du bsgyur bas yuṣ+mān/ asmān/ de gnyis las pha rol tu si byin pa la/ rtags rnam dbye dang bcas pa rim pa bzhin du/ twāṃ a haṃ du bsgyur ro// de bzhin du rtags rnam dbye dang bcas pa dzas la yu yaṃ wa yaṃ'o/ /nge la tu bh+yam ma h+yam mo/ /ngas la ta ba ma ma'o/ /de rnams kyi dper brjod ni gzhung gis grub la/ twata mata de dag gi gcig nyid la zhes pa'i skabs su dmigs bsal med pa'i gcig tshig ces bshad pa ltar na/ si la rnam dbye dang bcas zhes pa yang na ba med par mngon la/ dzas la yu yaṃ la ni yang na ba med do/ /gzhan rnams ni yang na bar gong du grub bo/ /gnyis pa la rtags la brten pa'i rnam dbye'i lus 'gyur/ rnam dbye la brten pa'i rtags kyi lus 'gyur/ de las 'phros pa'i 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ am dang au'ang ām mo/ /zhes dang*/ shas kyi ā na'o/ /zhes pa'ang rtags kyi dbang gis rnam dbye nyid 'gyur ba yin la|

'dir rtags de gnyis las rnam dbye lnga pa'i gnyis tshig bh+yam nyid ma yin pa ni at du bsgyur te/ rtags de gnyis las/ ngas si yang na twata/ mata/ yang na yuṣ+mata/ asmata nyid du gnas pa la'ang rung ste/ nga si at du bsgyur mtha' dbyi ba dang*/ rnam dbye'i rgyu mtshan can gyi a yig la rtags mtha'i a dbyi ba byas pas/ grub 'bras yang snga ma kho na ltar gnas pa dang*/ dur sing gis/ a ti sngon du bzhag pa'i rtags de gnyis la nga si byung nas/ yu wa ā war bsgyur nas 'di byas pas/ a ti yu wata/ a ti ā wata ces pa'ang mdzad do/ /'dir gnyis nyid ma yin pa ni/ gsum pa'ang yin mod kyi 'grel pa gnyis ka las/ nga si kho na'i dper brjod las gzhan ma mdzad la/ bh+yas ni a bh+yam mo zhes pa 'di la/ slob phan gyis bzhi pa'i mang tshig bh+yas zhes dmigs su bkar zhing*/ a mdo la/ dur sing du/ bh+yas tsam la sbyar ro/ /de gnyis las pha rol gyi slob phan ltar na bzhi pa'i mang tshig bh+yas ni a bh+yam du 'gyur zhing mtha' dbyi ba dang*/ a yig la dbyi ba byas pas yuṣ+ma bh+yam sogs/ ām la/ su ā ga ma byas pa'i sām ni rtags de gnyis ka la ā kaṃ du 'gyur te/ gong du bshad zin ta/ོ/ gnyis pa ni/ /skabs 'dir rnam dbye ma bsgyur ba/ ṭā dang*/ os gnyis dang ngi rnams pha rol tu byung ba na/ yuṣ+mata asmata dngos dang*/ de gnyis kyi lus 'gyur twat mat dang*/ yu wa ā wa rnams gang yin yang rung ste/ mtha'i dbyi ba byas shing*/ rtags mtha'i a yig e nyid du bsgyur nas mtshams sbyar ba bya ste/ dper brjod mang po brjod zin la/ ma brjod pa rnams kyang rtogs sla ba nyid do| |bhis dang*/ bh+yam dang*/ sup rnams kyang ma bsgyur zhing*/ slob phan ltar na lnga pa'i bh+yas kyang ma bsgyur ba min nam zhe na/ yin mod kyi/ de 'dra ba'i rnam dbye gsal byed dang po can la rtags mtha' ā nyid du bsgyur bar bya zhing*/ 'di la yang 'grel pa gnyis kar gyis ma bsgyur ba'i gsal byed ces gsungs mod kyi/

de la ni dur sing ltar na/ rnam bcad yod par ma mthong ste bsgyur ba'i gsal byed dang po ma dmigs pas so/ /slob phan ltar na/ bh+yas ni/ a bh+yam mo zhes pa'i bh+yam ni bsgyur ba'i gsal byed do/ /gsum pa ni nor gyi ming rai zhes pa'i rtags 'di'i mtha' yang gsal byed dang po can gyi rnam dbye pha rol la rtags mtha'i dbyangs ā nyid du bsgyur bas/ rai la/ si/ rāḥ rai/ bh+yas/ rā bh+yaḥlta bu'o/ /brgyad kyi ming aṣ+tan gyi mtha' ni thams cad ces pa rnam dbye'i mang tshig rnams la ā nyid du bsgyur ba spyir btang nas/ rtags de las pha rol gyi dzas dang shas dag ni au ru bsgyur bas/ aṣ+tau gnyis/ aṣ+ta bh+yaḥ aṣ+tā nām| aṣ+tā su/ rta'i ming arban zhes pa'i rtags 'di ni sngon du dgag pa na nya med pa yin na/ si min pa'i rnam dbye kun la/ arban+ti ru 'gyur bar nges so// brgya byin gyi ming ma gha wan zhes pa 'di ni/ si min par ma zad/ si la'ang mi gha wan+tu zhes par yang na 'gyur zhing*/ yang na gong du wa sgra u ru bsgyur bar bshad pa sogs bzhin no/ /de gnyis kyi mtha'i i dang u ni brjod don yin la| au sogs ghuṭ rnams la arban+tau/ ma gha wan+tau zhes sogs dang*/ si sogs gsal byed dang po la brtsegs pa'i mtha' phyis pas/ ma gha wān/ na'i u pa dhā ring por byas pa sogs dang*/ ṭā sogs ghuṭ yin pa'i dbyangs gsal byed la a nu ṣaṅga phyis pas/ arba tā/ ma gha wa tā zhes sogs so/ /rga ba'i ming dza rā zhes pa'i rtags 'di rnam dbye'i dbyangs bcu gsum la/ yang na dza ras zhes pa'i sa mtha' can du byas nas/ rnam dbye rang rang la gsungs pa'i bya ba bya ste/ dper na dzas la dza ras/ ma ning la dzas shi/ dhu ṭa dang dbyangs las ghuṭ la nu/ sa mtha' dang zhes pas na'i u pa dhā ring por btang bas dza rā n+si/ ṭā la/ dza ra sā| nge la/ dza ra se la sogs te sa mthar ma bsgyur na/ dza rā zhes pa shrādā dhā las gang gsungs pa rnams bya'o/

/gsum dang bzhi'i ming tri dang tsa twār zhes pa'i rtags 'di gnyis dag ni/ bud med brjod pa la rnam dbye'i dbyangs gsal pha rol la ti sṛ/ tsa ta sṛ zhes par 'gyur la/ khyad par ti sṛ dang*/ tsa ta sṛ'i ṛ de dag rnam dbye'i dbyangs pha rol la ra ru 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ bhis sogs gsal byed la ti sṛ bhiḥ tsa ta sṛ bhiḥ au dzas sogs dbyangs la/ ti srau/ ti sraḥsogs so/ /ti sṛ tsa ta sṛ de gnyis nām zhes pa nu dang bcas pa'i ām pha rol la rtags mtha' ring por 'gyur ba min pas/ ti sṛ ṇām/ mi'i ming nṛ zhes pa 'di'i dbyangs kyang*/ nām la ring por yang na 'gyur zhing yang na mi 'gyur bas nṛ nām/ nṝ ṇām/ rai'o zhes sogs nas/ 'di'i bar ni gsal byed dang po la ā nyid do zhes sogs la 'phros pa tsam du zad kyi yuṣ+mad sogs dang cha mthun dang*/ char gtogs sogs ni min na/ོ/ gnyis pa la/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs gsal gyi dang*/ kim gyi dang*/ da yig gi dang*/ i dm gyi dang*/ a das kyi lus 'gyur rnams so/ / dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sarba nā ma'i nang tshan/ t+yad/ tata/ yata/ e tata| a das/ i dm/ e k dwi rnams ni t+yat sogs yin la/ de rnams kyi mtha'i dbyangs dang gsal byed ni rnam dbye nyer gcig po pha rol la a yig tu 'gyur la/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs ni rnam dbye rgyu mtshan can gyi a yig pha rol la dbyi bar bya zhing rnam dbye rnams la rang rang gi a yig mtha' dang*/ ag+ni la bshad pa'i bya ba rnams bya'o/ /dper na/ si la/ s+ya/ saḥ yaḥ e tata la/ 'di dang si la sa'o/ /ta'i yang ngo zhes ta sa ru bsgyur/ nā mi dang*/ zhes pas sa ṣa ru bsgyur bas e ṣaḥsogs te/ da mar bsgyur ba sogs kyi dmigs bsal ni 'og nas ston no/ /gnyis pa ni/ t+yad sogs kyi nang na med kyang sarba nā ma'i nang tshan ci zhes pa'i ming kim zhes pa 'di rnam dbye kun la ka ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dper na si la kaḥ

dzas la dzas thams cad ī/ mtshams sbyar bas ke ām la/ ke ṣām/ de bzhin du tata la/ te ṣām/ yata la/ ye ṣā? ma/ kim sgrub na| kai sgra la'o/ /sup mtha' rin chen 'byung gnas su/ kā ya tis las ḍi mi'o// mi'i i brjod don/ḍa rjes 'brel sngar bzhin byas pas/ kima'/ོ/ gsum pa ni/ t+yat sogs kyi nang nas dwi min pa'i da yig rnam dbye la ma ru bsgyur bar bya'o// i dam la/ si la zur du 'chad pas/ au dzas/ am shas/ mtha'i ma dang sa a ru bsgyur ba sogs byas/ dzas ī a yig la dbyi shas kyis sa na ru bsgyur bas| i mau/ i me/ i maṃ/ i mān/ mi zad pa dang*/ sogs kyi mtha'i dbyangs las snga mar aka byas na/ i ma kau sogs 'byung bar dur sing las so| |'di spyir btang yin pas a das la'ang sbyar la/ de la ma las u nyid du byas nas mtshams sbyar bas/ a m+wau/ a m+wīsogs su 'gyur ram snyam ste / 'grel pa gnyis ka'i dper brjod kyis 'di i dam dang*/ si la sa'o zhes pa a das kyi da la sbyar ro/ /des na dwi ma yin pa'i da a das kyi da ni/ si la sa ru bsgyur bas/ a das/ si mtha' a yig da sa a das la/ si la au ste/ si dbyi ba yang ngo zhes pas/ a sau/ de bzhin du 'di la'ang*/ a sa kau dwi la ni/ mtha'i i a ru bsgyur bas/ dwaḥ dwau sogs so/ /des na t+yad sogs rnam dbye la/ mtha' dbyi bar bshad pa ni/ dbyangs gsal gnyis ka la sbyar gyi/ gsal byed rkyang pa la sbyor ba mi rigs so/ /de bzhin du si pha rol la/ t+yata/ tata/ e tata rnams kyi ta'i yang sa nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /s+yaḥ saḥ e ṣaḥ rnams te bshad zin to/ /bzhi pa ni rnam dbye si pha rol la i dam ni| ma ning gi rtags la/ i dam dang*/ bud med la i yaṃ dang*/ skyes pa la a yaṃ du 'gyur ba'o/ /i daṃ de nyid mi shes pa sogs kyi don la aka rkyen du byin pa yod med gnyis las/ aka la med pa'i i daṃ ni rnam dbye gsal byed dang po pha rol la/

i daṃ nyid at ces pa a yig thung ngu gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /i dam la| nge bh+yām/ bhis/ sup/ t+yat sogs kyi nge smai/ de las bhis/ bhir/ dhuṭ mang po sogs/ nā mi sogs kyis sa'i ṣa a yig sgra ldan sogs/ ra rnam bcad asmai/ ā bh+yām/ e bhiḥ e ṣu/ dbyangs la ni/ au/ i mau/ aka yod na i ma ke aka med pa'i i daṃ ni/ ṭā os dag la rtags a na zhes par 'gyur bas a ne na/ a na yoḥ aka yod na/ i ma ke na/ i ma ka yoḥ os la yang rtags mtha' e ru bsgyur ba'o/ /i dam du ma zad/ e tata kyi yang dgos pa gdams ngag lta bu rjes su bstan pa'i don la/ ṭā os su ma zad/ gnyis pa'i am la'ang rtags e na zhes par bsgyur bar bya'o/ /rjes bstan gyi don ni/ slob phan las/ gang du gcig gi dngos po cung zad tsam bsgrubs nas/ slar gzhan bstan pa ni/ rjes su bstan pa'o zhes so/ /i daṃ/ e tata/ am/ e naṃ/ ṭā/ e ne na/ os/ os la'ang ngo*/ /e a ya'o/ /e na yoḥ de yang slob ma 'di rig pa klo?g ces pa lta bu la/ shi ṣ+ya e naṃ bi da pa ṭhi ḍa/ 'dis klog ces ston na/ e ne na/ 'di'i ngang tshul bzang zer na/ shi ṣ+ya e na yoḥ pra bhu taṃ sogs so/ /mdo de ni e tata kyang bya ba khyad par ba la i daṃ dang 'dra zhes 'phros pa yin gyi/ i daṃ gyi 'chad 'phro ma chad pas na/ aka med pa'i i daṃ de las pha rol gyi bhis ni bhir du sgyur zhing*/ rtags ni gsal byed la aka med pa sogs kyi a dang*/ dhuṭ mang po sogs kyis e bhiḥsogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ a das las kyang bhis bhir du 'gyur la mtha' dbyi/ da ma/ dhuṭ sogs kyis e| 'og gi mang po nyid la ni/ eta ī nyid byas pas/ a mī bhiḥ a das de'i dbyangs mtha' si la au te si dbyi ba yang byas/ si la sa byas pas a sau/ 'di la aka med pa zhes pa mi 'jug pas/ aka yod kyang mtha' au ru byas pas a sa kau a das kyi lus 'gyur ma las pha rol de ma thag pa'i dbyangs ni u nyid du 'gyur la/

am/ shas/ nge*/ nga si/ ngas/ ngi rnams la a mum a mūn/ a muṣ+mai/ a muṣ+māta/ a mu ṣ+ya/ a muṣ+min rnams te/ ag+ni dang sarba nā ma'i bya ba byas pa'o/ /a das kyi ma'i dbyangs de rnam dbye mang po'i tshig nyid la ni u ru mi 'gyur bar e ru 'gyur zhing*/ et de ī nyid du 'gyur bas a mī bh+yaḥsogs so/ /zhar byung apa ces pa'i rtags 'di'i pa yig ni rnam dbye'i bha yig rnams la/ da ru 'gyur bas/ ad bhiḥ ad bh+yaḥ sogs te/ de ltar t+yata sogs brgyad kyi dang po gnyis de zhes pa la 'jugayat gang dang*/ de nas gsum 'di dang*/ de nas gnyis ni gcig dang gnyis la 'jug cing*/ 'di rnams shin tu rgyug che bas/ lus 'gyur rnams la zhib tu slob pa gal che zhing*/ gong gi yuṣ+mata asmata kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /

gsum pa la rtags mtha'i gsal byed la dang*/ thog mtha'i gsal byed la dang*/ rtags mtha'i dbyangs gsal gnyis ka la brten pa'i lus 'gyur ro/ /dang po la/ rtags mtha' da dang*/ ḍa dang ga ru bsgyur ba rnams so/ / dang po ni/ 'di nas sam+bud dhi la ma yin no zhes pa'i bar la/ rdzogs pa dang gsal byed dang po la zhes pa 'jug pas/ de khyad gzhir byas nas lus 'gyur rnams bya zhing*/ gsal byed dang po ni/ rnam dbye'i su bha rnams yin la/ su bha zhes mi brjod par/ gsal byed dang po zhes brjod pa ni/ rnam dbyer ma zad/ ya ma gtogs pa'i de phan gyi tā la sogs pa mtshungs pa'i gsal byed gzhan rnams la'ang a na h sogs kyi rtags mtha' da nyid du 'gyur bas gsal byed ces spyir byas par bshad la/ rdzogs pa zhes pa'i ngos 'dzin/ 'grel ṭīka kun tu ma byung yang tshig tu rdzogs pa'am/ rtags su rdzogs pa gang rung du mngon no// de yang 'og gi sam+bud dhi la ma yin no zhes dang*/ le'u'i mjug gi mdos si la dwogs pa dpyad pas/ mdo'i dgongs pa ni re shig si la rten pa'i bshad pa mi dgos par mngon zhing*/ slob phan nyid kyis su bha zhes smos rigs pa la/ gsal byed ces smos pa ni/ zhes rnam dbye'i nang nas su bha la brten pa'i lus 'gyur du khas blangs bzhin du'ang 'og gi mdo tha ma'i bshad pa skabs 'dir blangs nas dper brjod mdzad pa rnams ni/ cung zad 'khrugs pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bas/ re shig bha dang su la rten la brten pa'i rnam gzhag bya'o/ /de ltar na rtags mtha' rdzogs pa dang ghuṭ min pa'i rnam dbye gsal byed dang po can rnams pha rol la/ rtags/ a na h dang*/ na hi dang*/ wan+si zhes pa 'di rnams kyi mtha'i ha gnyis dang*/ sa yang da yig tu 'gyur ro/ /rtags phyi ma gnyis kyi i ni brjod don de rnams la bh+yam sup/ a na ha'i ngo*/ /zhes pas ghuṭ min pa'i gsal byed dang po la/ de'i wa sgra u sgra ldan la/

dhuṭ rnams kyi gsum pa dang*| sgra med pa la dang po byas/ tshig grogs rtags gsum rim bzhin/ su dang u pa dang su bid rnams sbyar bas/ swa na ḍud bh+yām/ swa na ḍu ta su/ u pa nad bh+yām/ u pa nata su/ su bi dwad bh+yāṃ/ su bi dwata su/ skad dod ni ba glang bzang po dang*/ nye bar rdzogs/ shin tu mkhas| zhes pa rnams rnam dbye dang sbyar ro// skabs 'di'i gsal byed dang po la rnam dbyes khyab bam zhe na ma khyab ste/ rtags mthar de phan gyi dngos po la tā twa dag go zhes pa'i tā'i rkyena'ang a na ḍut+hā/ u pa nat+hā/ bi dwat+hā/ zhes sogs 'byung ngo*/ /'on kyang de la des ma khyab ste| de phan gyi yaṇ'i rkyen la 'di'i bya ba mi byed de ā na h+ya/ au sa na h+ya bai dwa s+ya| de bzh-in du sran+su dang dh+wan+su 'og tu lhung ba'i byings la kwi pa/ it ma yin pa'i zhes pas a nu ṣaṅga phyis/ u gnyis brjod don/ de gnyis la/ bhis/ sup/ tā/ 'dis sa da'o/ /u khā srad bhiḥ u kha srat+su/ u khā srat+tā/ de bzhin du par+ṇa dh+wad bhiḥ dh+wat+su dhat+tā lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni de bzhin du rtags ha dang sha dang ṣa dang tsha rnams kyi mtha' dang yadz dang*/ sogs pas/ de wedz/ radz/ sṛdz/ mṛdza rnams kyi/ dza yig ḍa ru bsgyur te/ bhis dang sup la ma dhu lih/ su bi sha shaṣ/ prats+tsha/ yadz sogs rnams dang sbyar bas/ ma dhu liḍa bhiḥ ma dhu liṭa su sogs nas mṛṭ+su'o/ mṛd bhiḥ mṛḍa/ gsum pa ni/ duha 'jo ba'i byings la kwipa byin pa lta bu/ rtags da yig dang po can gyi mtha'i ha ni skabs 'dir ga ru bsgyur zhing*/ nyer bsgyur bi/ byings ha dang sogs kyis dang po bzhi par bsgyur bas/ bi dhu ga bh+yaḥ bi dhuk+su sogs so/ /wa tsa brjod pa la kwipa byung ba sogs tsa sde rnams dang*/ dṛ sha sogs rnams kyi rtags mtha'i gsal byed skabs 'dir ka yig tu bsgyur bas/ wāg+bhiḥ wāk+su/ dṛg+bhiḥ tṛk+su/ dṛsh sogs ni/

spṛsh ṛ twidz/ da dhṛsh pradz/ dish/ uṣ+ṇi ha rnams so/ /muh dang sogs pa dru ha dang ṣ+tih/ ṣ+ṇuh dngaṇash rnams kyi mtha'i gsal byed skabs 'dir ga yig tu yang na 'gyur ro/ /mug bh+yam/ muk+ṣu/ gnyis pa ni byings kyi cha shas ha dang*/ bzhi pa mtha' can/ gsum pa dang po can gyi rtags kyi yi ge dang po de ni sde pa kho rang gi bzhi pa nyid du skabs 'dir 'gyur ro/ /du ha sngon du go bzhag pas/ go du ha/ de bzhin du/ kāṣ+ṭha da h/ ni guha/ ar+tha bud dha bid bha rnams la bh+yam sogs/ ma byas pa dang 'dra bas/ da dang po'i sogs dang*/ ha sha sogs kyis rim pa bzhin ga dang ḍa ru bsgyur/ dhuṭa rnams kyi gsum pa dang supa la sgra med la dang po sogs byas pas/ go dhu ga bh+yām/ go dhuk+su/ de bzhin du kaṣ+ṭha dha ma ni ghuk+su/ ar+tha sogs la brtsegs pa'i mtha' phyis pas/ ar+tha bhud| bi dhab+bh+yām/ bi dhak+su/ dbyangs pha rol ni/ gong du hau sogs sa/ོ/ 'di thams cad la 'grel ṭīka rnams su si byin pa'i dper brjod kyang mdzad mod gong du bshad pa ltar/ 'og tu brjod par bya'o/ /sa dzuṣa dang ā shiṣa zhes pa'i rtags 'di dag gi sha log ni skabs 'dir ra yig tu 'gyur ro/ /ha sha ṣa tsha sogs kyis ḍa ru bshad pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /de gnyis la bh+yām dang twam sbyar| sa dzūr bh+yām/ sa dzūs+t+wam/ ā shīr bh+yām/ ā shīs+t+wam/ ir ur ces pas ring por btang ba dang*/ ra rnam bcad/ de ta la sa ru bsgyur ba'o/ /gsum pa ni| byings la kwipa byin pa'i lus 'gyur du song ba'i rtags la'ang byings zhes gsungs pas/ ming ler byings kyi ming btags pa rnams ni/ kwipa'i mtha' can gyi rtags yin no/ /des na dpang lo'i gdams pa shog gcig mar/ rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur rnams/ /brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ /zhes sgra'i yan lag thams cad/ rang bzhin dang*/ rkyen dang*/ rnam 'gyur gsum du bsdus nas/

rtags kyang rang bzhin byings kyi nang du bsdus pa ni legs pa yin mod| des na 'dir yang kwip'i mtha' can gyi byings kyi cha shas kyi mtha' ir ur dag ni īr ūr dag ces pa dbyangs ring por skabs 'dir 'gyur ro// dper na gṝ gnon par byed pa la'o/ /dhurbī 'tshe ba la'o/ /kṛt+ya yuṭ rnams las gzhan la'ang ngos/ zhes pas kwipa/ ṝt mtha'i yon tan med pa la ir ro// ra las dbyi bar bya ba dag go zhes pas gir/ dhur de gnyis la si bhis/ twam/ gīḥ dhūḥ gīr+bhiḥ dhūr+bhiḥ gīs+t+wam/ dhūs+t+wam/ byings kyi cha shas ma yin na/ sarbis dha nus| is us sgra ldan la rar song ba/ sarbir+bh+yām/ dha nur+bh+yām/ gsal byed dang po ma yin na/ gi rau/ dhu rau/ a han zhes pa'i rtags 'di'i na yig ni/ skabs 'dir sa yig tu 'gyur bas/ a han/ si bh+yām/ twam/ a haḥ a ho bh+yām/ a has+t+wam/ rtags mtha'i yi ge brtsegs pa'i mtha' ste/ 'og ma skabs 'dir dbyi ste/ pu man+sa/ si/ bhis/ sup/ si la sa mtha'i na u pa dhā ring po dang*/ gzhan gnyis la pu man+sa'i an gyi sgra dbyi ba byas pas/ pu mān/ puṃ bhiḥ puṃ su/ 'di rnams la sgra'i dper brjod kyi rnam par bzhag pa las yang na bar mthong ste| us+dza stobs kwipa'i mtha' can la/ tsa sde dang sogs byas pas/ urga bh+yām/ sogs mthong bas sa/ོ/ zhes pa slob phan las so/ /brtsegs pa'i dang po dhuṭ yin yang*/ skabs 'dir 'phyid pas/ rak+ṣa bsrung ba/ go sngon/ kwipa/ ha sha ṣa tsha sogs kyis ṣa ṭa/ sgra med la dang po sogs byas/ go ra ṭa/ go raḍa bh+yām/ go ra ma/ de bzhin du tak+ṣu phra mor byed/ u brjod don/ kwipa/ u pa taṭa/ u pa/ taḍ bh+yām sogs so// 'dir rtags mtha'i na yig ni dbyi bar bya bas/ rā dzṛ gsal| ṛ brjod don/ rā dzṛ sogs las ka nina'o zhes pas/ ka nin ka dang*/ in rjes 'brel/rā dzan/ si/ bh+yām/ twam/ rā dzā na mtha'i u pa dhā ring

pa'o// rā dza bh+yām/ rā dza twam/ rtags 'chad 'phro la rtags smos pa ni/ 'og nas byings kyi cha shas 'ga' re'i bya ba 'chad pa'i ched yin no/ /rtags mtha'i na dbyi ba de yang*| sam+bud dhi la bya ba ma yin no/ /he rā dzan/ he tak+ṣan/ de yang ma nges te he sā mān dang*/ he sā ma/ he warmān dang he warma zhes pa mthong bas so/ /zhes slob phan no/ /rtags mtha'i na dang brtsegs pa'i mtha'/ pu man+sa'i sa la sogs pa phyis pa ni/ yi ge snga ma'i cho ga la ma phyis pa bzhin du byas te/ rā dzan gyi na bh+yam la phyis rting*/ dza'i a yig sgra ldan la ring por mi 'gyur zhing*/ bhis dang sup la dhuṭ mang po la er mi 'gyur bas/ rā dza bh+yām/ rā dza bhiḥ sa phyis kyang na yig de la rtags mtha'i na dbyi ba'i cho ga med pas/ pu mān/ go man+ta'i ta phyis kyang go mān/ slob phan du mtshams sbyor gyi bya ba dang*/ ṣa'i bya ba la ma phyis pa dang 'dra ba las gzhan pa 'dod de zhes/ swā mi ī shwa ra dang*/ a ti pa ti dang*/ sā dhu kā ri ṣu rnams dper brjod du bshad pa 'di'i don gang yin zhe na/ 'di la bdag gi bla mas/ tsan+d+ra par/ swā dbang phyug la swā min no zhes rtags de min gyi mtha' can yin pa'i rtags mtha'i na phyis kyang*/ ma phyis pa dang 'dra bar mi byed de/ ma phyis na swā mi nī shwa ra yong dgos pa las swā mī shwa rar bshad pas so// zhes pa dang*/ sā dhu sngon ma can gyi ḍukṛnya la/ 'di'i kṛta rkang gnyis par/ nan+di sogs las yu'o/ /gra ha sogs las ṇi ni'o/ /zhes dang tsan+t+ra par/ nan+di dang gra ha sogs las ṇi ni dag go zhes pa gnyis ka'i 'grel par/ dbyangs mtha'i byings las sems dang mi ldan pa'i byed pa po la'ang ngo zhes/ nan+di dang gra ha sogs kyi nang na med pa'i gṛ lta bu la'ang dgos ched de'i don du ṇi ni 'gyur la/ de'i ṇa dang ni'i i rjes 'brel dang ṇa'i nus pa las 'phel ba byas pas kā rin zhes na mtha' yod pa supa la phyis pa na/

ma phyis pa'i tshe kā rin+su zhes par 'gyur yang*| de ltar mi byed par/ sā dhu kā ri ṣu zhes par byed pa'i don no/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di rigs shin tu mang la/ de dag ni legs sbyar gyi gzhung la dbang 'byor ba'i legs bshad do/ /a ti pa ti la bshad pa ma mdzad mod kyi/ 'di la'ang rtags kyi lus la dwaugs pa med pas/ rnam dbye su byin pa ṣu nyid du bsgyur ba'i dper brjod du gsal bas/ 'di la'ang pa tin zhes pa'i na mtha' can du yod pa phyis par gsal lo/ /rtags mtha'i sarbis lta bu'i is dang*/ dha nus lta bu'i us dang*/ dos zhes pa 'di rnams ni/ rnam dbye sgra ldan la sa ra yig tu 'gyur ba'o/ sarbir+bh+yām/ dha nu r+bh+yām/ dar+bh+yā+om/ sgra ldan ma yin na/ sarbiḥ ṣu sogs so/ /'di la'ang rtags byings kyi cha shas so/ /'di ni nā mi'i las pha rol gyi sa ṣar 'gyur ba'i dmigs bsal lo/ /rnam dbye sgra ldan la/ rtags mtha' dhuṭ rnams ni/ rang rang gi sde pa'i gsum par 'gyur ba'o/ /ag+ni sngon ma can gyi ma the rnam par dkrugs pa la/ kwipa sbyar ba'i tha yig bh+yām la dar bsgyur bas/ ag+ni mad bh+yām/ de bzhin du dzñā na budha la/ bh+yām/ dzñā na bud bh+yām mo| |sgra ldan min na/ dza gta su/ 'di ni gam+li 'gro/ l̥ yig ni pu ṣa sogs dh+yuta sogs l̥ yig rjes su 'brel ba/ arti sarti shāsti rnams las kyang*/ pa rasmai la'o zhes pa'i khyad par gyi don du rjes 'brel/ kṛ ta bzhi par/ d+yu ti gam dag gi gnyis dag kyang ngos/ kwipa dang byings gnyis/ de la a bh+yasa'i gsal byed dang po lhag mar byas pas snga ma ga nyid lus la/ ka sde'i tsa sde'o zhes pas ga dza ru bsgyur/ byings kyi mtha' pa rjes su 'brel pa la ta 'os/ ta ā ga ma byas shing*| yam mn tam gam rnams kyi kwipa la'o zhes pas ma phyis pas dza gta do// ag+ni ma th lta bu'i mtha'i sde pa'i gsal byed dhuṭa ni/ supa lta bu'i sgra med la dang por 'gyur bas/

ag+ni mat+su/ rtags mtha'i dhuṭa rnams rdzogs pa la yang na dang por 'gyur la/ yang na gsum par 'gyur bas ag+ni mata/ ag+ni mad sogs so| |rtags mtha'i re pha zhes pa ra dang sa yig dag ni/rnam par bcad pa nyid du bya'o/ /gir dhur/ pa yas/ ya shas sogs la si/ si gsal byed las zhig rjes giḥsogs su 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /rdzogs pa dang gsal byed dang po la brjod pa de rnams rnam dbye'i dbyangs dang*/ gsal byed phyis pa sogs la mi rung ngam snyam na/ de ni ma ning gi rtags las si dang am dag phyis pa la'ang 'gyur ba'o/ /'di la slob phan du/ nyi ma bzang ba la/ su dhu/ lam bzang ba la/ su pa thi/ zhes dper brjod mdzad pa ni/ gsal byed la dip'i u to/ pan+thi'i gsal byed la'ang 'di rnams kyi na'o zhes pa'i gsal byed kyi bya ba ni si am phyis pa la'ang byed ces par zad la/ dur sing*/ su wāka su wāg ces dper brjod mdzad pa ni/ si am phyis kyang tsa sde sogs dang*/ rdzogs pa sogs kyi bya ba byed ces gsungs pa yin pa/ gong gi rdzogs pa sogs nas bzung ste/ si la'ang bya ba mtshungs la/ am phyis pa la'ang mtshungs so/ /ming bzhi par rkang pa gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //bzhi pa la byed can dngos kyi rnam par bzhag par dang*/ zhar byung sgra'i yan lag spyi'i lus 'gyur dang*/ bud med kyi rtags bye brag tu bshad pa'/ོ/ dang po la byed can gyi lus 'gyur dang*/ byed can gyi ming 'dogs dang*/ byed can gyi 'jug yul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rnam dbye bye brag pa'i lus 'gyur dang*| mi zad pa nyid las rnam dbye spyi'i bya ba dang*/ de las 'phros pa'i zhar byung ngo*/ /dang po ni 'dir byed pa can zhes pa ni/ si sogs kyi rnam dbye sde tshan rnams la brjod pas/ de rnams kyi rtags khyad par ba la brten pa'i sgo nas lus 'gyur gyi dmigs bsal ston pas na/ sngar brjod pa'i rnam dbye'i lus 'gyur rnams ji skad brjod pa ltar nges sam zhe na/

rtags khyad par ba la ltos nas ma nges te/ gang gi snga ma brjod byar 'gyur/ /de ni mi zad gyur par 'dod// ces pa ltar mi zad pa'i tshig sdud du gyur pa/ nye ba'i bum pa'i ming*/ u pa kum+bha lta bu dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi ming u pa sa māp+ta zhes sogs a yig mtha' las pha rol tu byung ba'i lnga pa min pa'i rnam dbye bco brgyad po rnams thams cad am du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /zhes spyir btang nas/ rnam dbye gsum pa dang*// bdun pa dag gi yang na am du 'gyur la yang na ṭā i na sogs kyi bya ba bya'o/ de yang slob phan la brten pa'i 'grel ṭīka tu/ mi zad par gyur pa zhes pa'i gzhung tshig gsal du btang ba med kyang*/ bu ston rin po che'i ṭī kar/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba zhes gsungs pa ni/ dur sing gi 'grel pa'i bzhed pa yin la/ 'og tu mi zad pa las kyang 'jig ces pas kyang*/ 'di 'grub ste/ snga ma mi zad pa'i tshig sdud kyi dbang du ma byas na/ gzhung la de ma thag tu nang 'gal du 'gyur bas so/ /des na gsum bdun las gzhan kun la rnam dbye gang byung yang am du bsgyur/ rnam dbye'i a yig la rtags mtha'i a phyis pas/ grub 'bras thams cad/ u pa kubhaṃ zhes pa kho nar gyur pa ni/ tshig grogs kyi 'byed dgos pas/ de i dam dang sbyar na/ bum pa 'di zhes dang po'i rjes dang*/ dṛ sh+ya dang sbyar na bum pa la lta zhes pa'i dang*/ da ho dang sbyar na/ bum pa la dga' zhes pa'i dang*/ rū pa dang sbyar na/ bum pa'i gzugs ces drug pa'i rjes su shes so/ /de bzhin du u pa sa māp+ta la'ang 'dra ste/ su kar+t+ra sogs nyer bsgyur sngon ma can gyi mi zad pa'i tshig sdud kun la 'dra'o/ /gsum bdun la ni/ u pa kum+bham gnyis/ u pa kum+bhe na/ u pa kum+bhe/ lnga pa la ni nga si āta/ u pa kum+bhata sogs su nges kyi yang na ba med do/ /'dir lnga pa am du mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ni sus kyang ma bshad pas dpyad par bya'o/

/tshig sdud de a yig thung ngu'i mtha' can las gzhan las rnam dbye kun 'jig cing*/ tshig sdud de ni ma ning gi rtags su 'dod ces dang*/ ma ning la dbyangs thung ngu'o zhes pas/ u pa ba dhū sogs dbyangs ring po rnams kyang thung ngur bsgyur zhing*/ rnam dbye nyid kyi lus 'gyur cung zad kyang med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ der ma zad mi zad pa'i ming can gyi rtags kun las kyang rnam dbye mtha' dag 'jig go /rtags de ni/ tsa| wā/ hā/ a ha/ e wa/ no/ haṃ ho/ u tā ho/ ho/ a ho/ a tho ste/ bcu gcig po 'di rnams mi zad pa dang*/ ni pā da gnyis ka yin la/ an+tar/ swar/ prā tār/ pu nar/ a dhar/ a pi/ a har rnams mi zad pa rkyang pa yin par bshad cing*/ 'di'i thad kyi slob phan du/ tsa wā hā ste gsum gyi dper brjod dang*| dur sing du de gsum dang*/ an+tar/ prā tar gnyis bsnan no/ /gsum pa ni/ gong gi 'jig go zhes pa'i mdo gsum ka'i mjug tu sbyar zhing*/ mang po nyid la dang*/ bud med min pa la dang*/ bu brgyud kyi rkyen zhes pa rnams 'og ma gnyis la'ang sbyar ro/ /yul ljongs kyi sgo nas ming du btags pa'i rgyal po dang*/ blon po sogs kyi ming ni grags pa rnams zhes bya zhing*/ de rnams kyi ming la rnam dbye rnams kyi mang po'i tshig nyid sbyar ba la/ brjod bya bud med min pa brjod pa la/ bu brgyud kyi rkyen gyis 'jig par 'gyur ba'o/ /gyi ni/ de 'jig ces par zad kyi/ de'i khyad par sogs mi ston no/ /dper na/ yul/ ang ga dang*| wang ga dang/ ma gha dha dang*/ ka ling ga sogs kyi rgyal po rnams ces pa la| ang ga rā dza sogs 'byung la/ de rnams kyi bu brgyud brjod pa la/ bu brgyud la aṇa yang na'o/ /zhes pas an byin/ ṇa yig ni ṇa dang bcas pa las dang por 'phel ba'o/ /zhes pas rtags gzhan la mi 'jig pa'i tshe/ dang po'i dbyangs la 'phel ba 'byung yang*/ 'dir 'jig cing*/ 'jig pa'i dbyi ba la rkyen gyi bya ba min no zhes pas 'phel ba mi byed cing*/

a yang phyis nas mang tshig dzas byin na/ ang ga rā dzāḥ zhes sogs su 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ garga dang*/ de'i sogs khongs/ bat+sa/ badz/ yaska dang*/ de'i sogs khongs/ ladz+dza/ dru ha/ bid dang*/ sogs khongs/ ur+wa/ ba ra dh+wā dza rnams la'ang*/ garga sogs las ṇ+ya'o zhes sogs bu brgyud kyi rkyen byin kyang mang tshig dang bud med min pa la rkyen 'jig cing de'i bya ba med do/ /de bzhin du bhṛ+-i gu sogs rtags drug la'ang de 'dra zhing*/ rnam dbye la brten pa'i rtags mtha'i lus 'gyur spyir btang bzhin byas pas/ bhṛ gu dzas/ bhṛ ga waḥ a tri dzas/ a tra yaḥ de rnams la bu brgyud kyi rkyen ni/ a tri las e yaṇa ྄dang*/ gzhan rnams la aṇa'o/ /de gnyis la dzas ag+ni'i bya ba byas pa'o/ /slob phan du/ garga sogs kyi mtshan gzhi rgyas par bshad pa ni/ garga dang*/ bat+sa dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ saṃ kṛ ti dang*/ prā mān dang*/ bya gh+rā pā da dang*/ a dza dang*/ be da dang*/ bhu ma rnams ni garga sogs so/ /yaska dang*/ ladz+dza dang*/ dru ha dang*/ a yas+thū ṇa dang*/ bha lan da ra rnams ni yaska sogs so/ /bi da dang*/ ur+wa dang*/ ba ra dh+wā dza dang*/ kurbā tsā ra dang*/ a wa dang*/ u pa ma n+hu kwa sh+ya pa rnams bi da sogs so/ /mang tshig min na si byin/ gārgyaḥ yāska/ bai daḥ bhārgā waḥ ātre yaḥ sogs te/ 'di la u yig rnams ni o nyid du thob ces dang*/ o yig dang au yig dag gi'ang a wa dang ā wa ru bsgyur ba dang*/ a tri'i i'i yi ge dang*/ a'i yi ge dag dbyangs dang ya'i rkyen la dbyi ba byas pa dang gzhan rnams rtogs sla'o// gnyis pa ni le'u 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo ni/ byed can drug yin la/ de rnams kyang gang zhe na/ dpang los/ ngo bo las dang byed pa ched/ /'byung khungs bzhi rnams byed can drug/drug brgyad spangs pa zhes gsungs te/ bod pa yang*/ rnam dbye brgyad par bzhed pas/ brgyad kyi nang nas drug pa dang*/ brgyad pa spangs pa rnams 'dir kā ra kā zhes yang yang bshad pa'i byed can yin la/

de rnams la sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bkod pa'i ming 'dogs khyad par can mdzad pa ni/ nges par kun sbyin pa sogs te/ de yang nges par kun sbyin pa ni lnga'o/ /yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /gnas gzhi ni bdun pa'o// byed pa ni gsum pa'o/ /las ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang byed mkhan de byed pa po'/ོ/ zhes pas ni dang po ngo bo ston par bzhag dgos te/ de lta min na skabs 'dir byed can drug mi tshang bas so/ /'o na de'i dper brjod rnams su gsum pa nyid bshad pa ci zhe na/ byed pa por 'jog pa la byed pa zhig gis khyad par du byed dgos pas yin no/ /des na 'dir de rnams kyi ming 'dogs dang*/ ngo bo ngos 'dzin gnyis ka 'chad pa yin te/ slob phan du/ nges par kun sbyin pa sogs gang du dgos ce na/ 'og gi nges par kun sbyin pa zhes sogs su dgos ces dang*| de bzhin du byed pa po la'o zhes sogs dang rgyu zhes pa/ byings las kyang rgyu la'o zhes sogs su dgos zhes brda chad du gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na grong khyer las 'bral zhes pa lta bu/ gang las 'bral ba'am/ chom rkun las 'jigs pa lta bu/ gang las 'jigs pa'am/ slob dpon nam mkhan po las rig pa len pa lta bu gang las len pa'i don ston pa de/ nges par kun sbyin pa'i ming can rnam dbye lnga pa byung ba'i yin no zhes pa'o/ /dper na grong nas 'ong nges la/ grā ma/ ngasi/ ā ta/ grā māt/ pha rol tu ā gats+tsha ti zhes pa dang mtshams sbyar bas grā mā dā gats+tsha ti/ de bzhin du/ chos min las log pa la/ adharmān+ni/ warta ti/ rta dang shing las lhung ba la/ ashwāt/ bṛk+ṣā ta/ pa ta ti rnams so/ /chom rkun rnams las 'jigs pa la/ tsau ra bh+yas/ dhuṭ mang po/ tsau re bh+yo bi bhe ti/ mkhan po las rig pa len la/ u pā dh+yā yāt/ bi d+yām/ ā dat+te/ bang ba nas 'bru len pa la/ goṣ+ṭha gā rāta/ dhā n+ya gṛ ha te/ rnams mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/

/der ma zad mngon par 'dod pa bsrung ba'i don ston pa'i byings dang sbyor ba rnams kyi tshig la yang*/ nges par kun sbyin pa'i rnam dbye can zhes bya'o/ /nas rnams las ba lang bsrung la/ ya be bh+yo gā ra rak+ṣa ti/ til las bya rog bzlog la/ tī le bh+yaḥ kā kān/ wā ra ya ti/ sbrul rnams las bu bsrungs la/ a hi bh+yaḥ pu traṃ rak+ṣa tiḥ khron pa las long ba bzlog la/ kū pāt/ an dhaṃ wā ra ya ti/ sbyin sred 'dzin pa gsum ga'i sngon du/ gang gi ched du zhes pa sbyar nas/ de rnams byed pa'i don la 'jug pa'i byed pa can gyi rnam dbye ni/ yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa zhes bya'o/ /bram ze la bsod snyoms byin la/ bi pra/ nge*/ nge ya a yig sgra ldan sogs/ bi prā ya bhak+ṣaṃ da dā ti/ mkhan po la ba glang 'bul la/ u pā dh+yā yā ya gā da dā ti/ lha sbyin la la du yi gar 'ong la/ de ba dāt+tā ya ro tsa te mo da ka mchod sbyin gyi phyir brgya tham pa 'dzin la/ yadzñā dāt+tā ya sha ta dhā ra ya te zhes sogs so/ /rten gang brten pa kun nas 'dzin par ston pa de gnas gzhi'o/ /zho la mar yod la/ da dhi la/ ngi*/ as+thi sogs kyi mtha' an/ wa ma sogs kyi mtha' an gyi a phyis pas/ dadh+ni ghṛ taṃ asti/ sor mo'i rtse na glang chen khyu brgya yod la/ ang gu li/ agra ngi*/ mtshams sbyar bas/ ang gu l+ya gre hasti yū tha sha taṃ asti sogs so/ /zor bas gcod pa lta bu'i gang gis bya ba gang byed pa de ston pa ni byed pa'i rnam dbye'/ོ/ zor bas dang sta res gcod la/ da tra la/ ṭā i na/ da dre ṇa/ lū no ti/ par shu nā tsi no ti/ re lde bya ba lta bu gang bya ba ston pa de las kyi rnam dbye'o/ /ka ṭa am/ ka ṭaṃ ka ro ti/ re lde byed ces pa'o/ /zan 'tshed la/ o da naṃ pa tsa ti/ nyi ma la blta/ ā di t+yaṃ pa sh+ya ti/ sh-ing gcod mkhan lta bu/ gang byed mkhan de ston pa ni/ byed pa po'i rnam dbye'o/ /drag po dang khyab 'jug gis byas la/

ru tre ṇa kṛ taṃ/ biṣ+ṇu nā kṛ taṃ/ gang byed du 'jug pa de 'og nas rgyu'i don la'o// zhes sogs kyi ming can gyi rnam dbye yin la/ byed can drug gi nang nas byed pa po ngo bo brjod pa yin pas/ zur du ming bgrang bas 'ang sgra smos so/ /byed du klog tu bcug pa la/ kā rā ya ti/ pā ṭha ya ti/ gsum pa la spyir btang*/ dmigs bsal lo/ /dang po ni/ byed can drug po de rnams kyi nang nas/ byed can gnyis dag yul gcig la 'thob pa'i tshe/ pha rol te phyi ma'i don gyi rnam dbye de sbyin par bya'o/ /dper na shing las bya rog skrod par bya zhes pa'i don la/ lnga pa dang gnyis pa gnyis ka thob pa la/ phyi ma gnyis pa sbyar bas/ bṛ k+ṣaṃ t+ya dza ti kha gaḥ de bzhin du dbyug pa can las dbyug pa phral bar bya'o la lnga pa pha rol dbyug pa can yin pas/ de la si byin nas/ ī yig mtha' las si dbyi ba byas pas/ t+ya dza ti/ daṇ+ḍaṃ/ daṇ+ḍī/ rtags kyi don gyi tshig la zhes pa/ rtags tshig tu sgrub par byed pa la si sogs kyi rnam dbye ster ba bya ba yin la/ de yang don tsam ston pa'i tshig tu bsgrub pa la/ rnam dbye dang po gsum po gang rung sbyin par bya'o/ /bṛk+ṣa/ ku mā rī/ nī la rnams la/ si/ rtags de gsum rim bzhin pho mo ma ning gi rtags yin pas/ sa rnam bcad dang*/ ī yig mtha' las si dbyi ba dang*| ma ning las si dbyi zhing*/ a yig las sam+bud dhi ma yin pa la mu rnams byas pas/ bṛk+ṣaḥ ku mā rī/ nī laṃ/ rnam dbye dang po yin na/ don tsam la ster bas khyab bam zhe na/ ma khyab ste/ bod pa'i don la yang de gsum ka ster bas so/ mañdzu shrī/ bod si/ hemañdzu shri/ tā rā/ bod si/ shrad+dhā las sam+bud dhi la'ang ngos/ e/ tā re/ rnam dbye dang po rnams don tsam dang*/ bod pa la 'jug na/ lhag ma rnams gang la 'jug ce na/ de lhag ma rnams kyi 'jug yul yod de/ gnyis pa las dang*/ gsum pa byed pa dang*/

bzhi pa yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa dang*/ lnga pa nges par kun sbyin pa dang*/ drug pa bdag po'am rje bo la sogs pa lta bu la dang*/ bdun pa gnas gzhi rnams la 'jug pas sa/ོ/ shā sa naṃ kṛt+ya ka ro ti/ bstan pa la bya ba byed/ tsakre ṇats+tshe dang*/ 'khor los gcod| na mo bud dhā ya/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ dha rmāt+su kha bha waṃ/ chos las bde ba 'byung*/ saṃ gha s+ya se na/ dge 'dun gyi sde/ bṛ k+ṣe ḍī na/ shing la bya zhes sogs te/ rnam dbye'i lus 'gyur spyir btang bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la lnga pa nyer bsgyur dang brjod byas dang gnyis pa rkyen dang brjod tshul gyis dang*/ bzhi pa sbyor tshul dang brjod byas dang*/ gsum pa khyad chos dang bya byed kyis dang*| bdun pa brjod bya dang tshig grogs kyis dang*/ drug pa rgyu mtshan dang dgos pas 'jug par bstan pa'o/ /

dang po ni/ rnam dbye de rnams sngar ji skad bshad ma thag pa'i 'jug yul so sor nges sam zhe na/ rnam dbye dang po la ni don tsam dang*/ bod pa las gnas pa'i dmigs bsal med la/ gzhan rnams ni bya dang dgos pa sogs kyi dbang gis gzhan du 'gyur ba yang yod ces ston pa ste/ de yang lnga pa ni 'byung khungs mi ston yang rung ste/ nyer bsgyur pa ri dang*/ apa dang*/ āng rnams dang sbyor ba'i rtags la yang sbyor te/ pa ri shru gh+nāta/ de bo bṛṣ+taḥ a pa ka n+ya kus+dzāta de bo bṛṣ+taḥ ā ku ru k+ṣe trāta de bo bṛṣ+taḥ zhes pa'i dper brjod 'di rnams slob phan du gsungs shing*/ pa ri sogs kyang sbyar ba'i las rab tu brjod pa'i don la gnyis pa thob pa la 'dir lnga pa brjod pa yin gyi nyer bsgyur rkyang pa'i nus pa min te/ pa ri bh+ra ma ṇaṃ/ a pa sa ra ṇaṃ/ ā na ya naṃ/ zhes sogs la gnyis pa nyid sbyor bar gsungs so/ /dur sing las ni nyer bsgyur gyi nus pa tsam las gzhan ma bshad do/ /de bzhin du phyogs dang i ta ra dang*/ ṛ te dang*/ gzhan pa'i skad dod a n+ya rnams kyis sbyor ba'i rtags las kyang 'byung khungs mi brjod kyang*/ lnga pa 'gyur te/ dper na grong gi shar na zhes pa lta bu bdun pa'i don la pūrbo grā māta ces grong las shar zhes pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du grong khyer gyi lho na la/ dak+ṣi ṇa na ga rāta/ lha sbyin gyi gcig shos ces drug pa'i don la/ i ta ro de wa dat+tāta/ mkhas pas bor ba dag ci'i phyir grol/ zhes gsum pa'i don la/ paṇ+ḍi ta ṛ t+yai ku to mok+ṣāta/ lha sbyin gzhan yin la/ a n+yo de ba dat+tāta/ gnyis pa ni grong gi lho dang*/ byang na gnas lta bu bdun pa'i don can yin kyang*/ e na'i rkyen mtha' na gnas pa'i sgra yis sbyor ba la gnyis pa 'gyur te/ dak+ṣi ṇe na grā mi ba sa ti/ ut+ta re ṇa ga raṃ ba sa ti/ shing rnam par gsal bar byed pa'i klog ces pa lta bu a nu la sogs pa'i las rab tu brjod pa rnams kyis sbyor ba'i rtags las gnyis pa 'gyur te/

bṛk+ṣaṃ a nu bi d+yo ta te bi d+yuta/ 'di ni gnyis pa las kyi don la zhugs pas dmigs bsal du 'grub par dka' mod/ brjod bya lhag po gcig med na/ mdo smos pa don med du 'gyur bas/ brjod pa zhes pa'i tshig la nus pa 'don nam snyam te brtag par bya'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis pa dang*/ thung mong ba'i dang*/ bzhi pa dgos kyi 'jug tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ tṝ rkyal bar byed pa dang*/ sgrol bar byed pa la'/ོ/ zhes dang*/ gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /zhes pa lta bu 'gro ba'i don can gyi byings las bsgrub pa'i las ston pa'i rtags gang dag gi las la bya ba yul la yod pa'i dang*| byed pa po la yod pa gnyis las/ lam lta bu dang po ma yin par phyi ma yin pa de la'ang g.yo bzhin pa yin min gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dag 'jug ste/ tir+thaṃ gats+tsha ta/ tir+thā ya gats+tsha ti/ zhes sogs so| |de yang gnyis pa ni spyir btang bya ba'am/ las kyi don can yin pa dwogs pa chung la/ bzhi pa'i dmigs bsal gtso che'o/ /de bzhin du slob phan du/ lam brjod pa la| pan+tha naṃ gats+tsha ti/ zhes gnyis pa nyid 'jug pa'i dper brjod mdzad do/ /'o na bzhi pa dang de lhan cig smos pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ byed pa po dang las dag la kṛta la rtag tu'o/ /zhes sogs kyi dmigs bsal du 'dir 'gyur bas drug pa'i don la 'di gnyis la 'jug ces kyang slob phan las so/ /der ma zad ma n+ya zhes pa yid yin pas yid kyi las la'ang de gnyis 'jug ste/ de yang yul srog chags min pa dang*/ bya ba ma gus pa ste brnyas pa brjod na'o/ /rtswar yang khyod mi sems zhes pa la tṛ ṇaṃ a pi s+t+waṃ/ na ma n+ye// gnyis pa ni na ma dang*/ swa sti dang*/ swā hā dang*/ swā dhā dang*/ nus pa'i skad dod a lam dang*/ wa ṣaṭa rnams dang sbyor ba'i rtags la bzhi pa'i rnam dbye gsum po rnams sbyar bar bya'o/ /'di rnams kyang de dang de la bya ba 'di byed ces pa'i bya ba'am las brjod pa yin kyang*/

bzhi pa dgos ched kyi rnam dbye 'jug pas/ bzhi pa'i dmigs bsal khyad par can yin zhes pa'o// 'di rnams ni/ 'di'i thad kyi 'grel ṭīka rnams su/ dper brjod mdzad pa'ang yod mod kyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi mdor bsdus su/ oṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥ na mo de we bh+yaḥ swa sti pra dza bh+yaḥ swā hā rā dza bh+yaḥ swa dha bhu te bh+yaḥ a laṃ pi tṛ bh+yaḥ wa ṣaṭa in+d+rā ya/ bod skad du/ oṃ sa 'og sa steng mtho ris kyi/ /lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye rgu rnams la bde legs dang*/ /rgyal po rnams la legs sbyin dang*/ /'byung po rnams la dbugs dbyung dang*/ /pha mes rnams la nus pa dang*/ /dbang po rnams la dbang byed 'gyur/ /zhes pa bzhi pa'i bh+yas dang*| tha ma la nge byin/ bar pa gnyis la na phyis pas snga ma'i cho ga la/ ma phyis pa bzhin byas pas/ dhuṭa mang po nyid la e sogs ma byas pa'o/ /dgos ched de'i don nyid la ni bzhi pa 'gyur te/ de wār+tha tā yakṛṭa/ lha'i don du byed/ 'di ni bzhi pa nyid 'jug yul gyi gtso bo brjod pa yin nam snyam mo/ /tum dang mtshungs pa'i don la dngos po brjod pa'i rkyen gyi mtha' las kyang bzhi par 'gyur ro/ /pā ka dang ka ra ṇa dang*/ saṃ s+thi ti dang*/ ā shra ya/ rnams la bra dza ti zhes pa sbyar ba'i bar du nge byin/ pā kā ya/ bra dza ti zhes sogs te/ 'tshed du/ byed du/ gnas su/ nyal du 'gro zhes pa rnams so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bu dang lhan cig pa'i pha 'ongs so zhes pa lta bu drug pa'i don gtso che ba sbyor ba la gsum pa nyid du 'gyur te/ pu tre ṇa/ sa ha/ ā ga taḥ pi tā/ pu tre ṇa sa ha s+thū la/ pu tre ṇa sa ha go mān/ 'bras bu sgrub pa dang ldan pa'i dngos po ni rgyu yin la/ de'i don la'ang gsum pa 'gyur te rig pas grags/ bu mos mya ngan zhes pa la/ bid+yā ṭā/ ṭā os zhes pas/ shrad dhā e/ e a ya/ bi d+ya yā ya shaḥ de bzhin du ka n+ya yā sho kaḥ

'di ni gang byed du 'jug pa de rgyu'o zhes byed pa'i nang du bsdus pas/ gsum pa'i 'jug tshul gyi dmigs bsal ma yin pa'/ོ/ smad pa'i don la'ang gsum pa ste/ de yang yan lag mig dang mgo lta bu smad pa'o/ /mig long ba la ak+ṣ+ṇā ka ṇā/ 'di ni ak+ṣa laḥ ṭā/ a s+thi da dhi sogs kyis mtha' an/ wa ma brtsegs sogs kyis mthar dbyi ba byas pa'o/ /mgo bo spyi ther la/ shi ra sā khal+li ḍaḥ shi ras la ṭā'o/ khyad chos gang zhig gis khyad par byed pa'i don brjod pa la'ang gsum pa ste/ ral pa rnams kyis dka' thub par mthong la/ dza ṭā bhistā pa so dṛ ṣ+ta ṭhaḥ ta pa brtul brdung*/ a sun de phan aṇa si'o/ /de bzhin du ral gris rje bor mthong ba la/ khaṭa ge na bha ṭo dṛṣ+taḥ byed pa po brjod pa la'ang gsum pa ste/ drag pos grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs la/ ru tre ṇa dag+dha tri pu raṃ/ khyab 'jug gis stobs ldan bcings la/ biṣ+ṇu nā/ ban+dha ba la/ lnga pa ni/ gnas gzhis khyad par du ma byas kyang dus dang dngos po bstan pa dag la bdun par 'gyur te/ ston ka 'dab ma bdun pa rgyas la| sha rata la/ ngi sbyar bas/ sha ra di puṣ+pan+ti sap+ta ts+tsha dāḥ dbyar ka dug mo nyung rgyas la/ war+ṣāl/ supa/ war+ṣā su puṣ+pan+ti ku ṭa dzā ni/ rje dang dbang phyug dang mnga' bdag dang bgo skal dang*/ dbang po dang*/ gnya' bo dang*/ btsas pa rnams kyi ming*/ swā mi dang*/ ī shwa ra dang*/ a dhi pa ti dang*/ dā yā da dang*/ sāk+ṣi dang pra ti bhu dang*/ pra sū ti rnams kyi drug pa sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i rtags la ni| chos kyi rje zhes brjod na drug pa 'gyur zhing*/ don de brjod pa la*/ chos la rje zhes pa lta bu'i bdun pa'ang 'gyur la/ gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin te/ kun la ngi dang*/ ngas sbyar nas/ dharme swā mi/ dharma s+ya swā mī/ a'i yi ge i'i yi ge sogs dang ngas s+ya'o/ /de bzhin du nor gyi dbang phyug la dha na yī shwa raḥ dha na s+ye shwa raḥ

yul phyogs kyi bdag po la/ de sha ya ti pa ti/ de sha pyā ti pa ti| longs spyod kyi bgo skal la/ saṃ bho ke dā yā daḥ saṃ bho ka s+ya dā ya daḥ nor gyi dbang po la/ dha ne sāk+ṣi/ dha na s+ya sāk+ṣi/ nor gyi gnya' bo la dha ne pra ti bhu+i| dha na s+ya pra ti bhū/ ba glang btsas pa la/ ga wi pra sū ta goḥ pra sū ta/ rigs dang yon tan dang bya ba sogs kyi gzhan las nges par bkar ba'i don la'ang rnam dbye dpya gnya.as so/ /dper na/ skye bo rnams kyi rgyal rigs dang*// bud med rnams kyi sngo bsangs legs/ /'gro ba rnams kyis rgyug pa mgyogs// chos dkar rnams kyis dad pa mchog/ces pa'i don la/ pu ru ṣā ṇāṃ k+ṣat+t+ri ya shū raḥ sh+yā mā nā rī nāṃ dar+ṣā nī yā/ dh+wa gā nāṃ shī gh+raṃ gāḥ dharma shī tā nāṃ shrad dhā grāḥ 'di rnams ni drug pa'i āṃ gyi rjes yin la/ bdun pa'i sup byin na/ pu ru ṣe ṣu/ nā dī ṣu/ dh+wa ge ṣu/ shī te ṣu rnams so/ /drug pa ni rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs kyi ming*| he tu sbyor ba'i don la drug pa 'gyur te/ rig pa'i phyir dang*/ zas kyi phyir 'di ru sdod/ ces pa la bid+yā/ ngas/ nga ldan rnams so/ /bid+yā yāḥhe tu ngas/ nga si ngas dag gi a dbyi ba yang ngos/ /he toḥ sdod pa'i skad dod/ ba sa ti/ bi d+yā yāḥhe tor ba sa ti/ an+na s+ya he tor wa sa ti/ bla ma la dmigs nas dran pa skye ba la bla ma dran zhen pa lta bu/ dran pa'i don can gyi las la'ang drug pa ste/ ngas byin na a dbyi ba byas/ gu roḥsma ra ti/ chos dran pa la/ dharma s+ya dh+yā ya ti zhes pa'o/ /'di dag la'ang chos kyi dran pa zhes mi brjod kyi chos dran zhes bya'o// de bzhin du pha dang ma la/ pi tuḥ mā tuḥ dang sbyar ro/ /ka ro ti'i las la 'bad pas rtogs par bya bzhin pa la drug par 'gyur te/ chu 'phel gyi bya ba la yang dag par 'bod la/ e dho da ka s+yo pa saṃ sku ru te/ de yang e dha sngon ma can gyi u da ka la/

ngas s+ya/ u pa dang*/ saṃ sngon ma can gyi ḍu kṛnya la/ brta ma ni'i te/ kun bshad pa bdun par/ saṃ pa ring u pa las rgyan la suṭa'o zhes pas/ su ṭa ā ga ma'o/ /u dang ṭa rjes 'brel/ tan sogs las u'o zhes pas rkyen u/ ka ro ti 'os/ ṛ yig gi yon tan ar/ byings thams cad pa la yon tan med pa la a'i u yig go zhes pas/ ar gyi a u/ ku ru te zhes sbyar ba'o/ /'tshe ba'i don can gyi byings las/ dz+wa ri ma yin pa'i las rjod pa la drug pa 'gyur te/ rkun pos 'tshe bar gyur pa'i nad ces pa/ tsau ra s+ya ru dza ti ro gaḥ rkun po'i nad kyis gzir zhes pa la tsau ra s+yā la ya ti to daḥ dz+wa ra dang sbyor na gnyis pa'i am mo| |spyir byed pa po dang las brjod par byed pa dag la dus rtag tu drug pa 'gyur la/ de yang kṛta kyi rkyen gyi mtha' can yin na'o/ /bha wa n+ta/ ngas/ a nu ṣaṅga phyis/ as sdod pa la'o/ /g-im+lā'agro dpya gnya.as kyi sngon du a gra tud rim 'os pa/ bu len zhes pas bunya'o/ /yu bu dzha zhes pas aka ru bsgyur/ āpa/ ka'i rkyen la zhes pas i/ bha wa to gra si kā bha wa to gra ga mi kā/ las la badz+ra s+ya war+t+tā bhu wa na s+ya rak+ṣi ta snga ma gnyis khyod mchog tu gnas dang 'gro phyi ma gnyis/ rdo rje la 'jug pa dang*/ dngos po la bsrung ba zhes drug pa'i dmigs bsal khyad par ba'o/ /de bzhin du sems can thams cad la zhi ba dang bsrung bar mdzod ces pa/ sarba sa twā nāṃ shān+tīṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ruḥ zhes dang*/ na maḥ sa man+ta bud dhā nāṃ/ zhes sangs rgyas la kun nas phyag 'tshal lo zhes sogs la drug pa'i āmasbyar ba shin tu mang ngo*/ /'o na byed pa po dang las dag la kṛta kyi rkyen yin na drug pas khyab bam zhe na/ ni ṣ+ṭha sogs la ma yin te/ k+ta dang k+ta wan+tu dag ni ṣ+ṭha 'o zhes dpya gnya.as dang*/ kwan+su dang kā na dang shan+tṛ dang*/ ā na sha dang*/ ki dang u dang*/ uka nya dang*/ iṣ+ṇa dang*/ kwa dang*/ khal dang*/

yu dang*| shā nang dang*/ tṛ ṇa dang wuṇa dang*/ ṇin rnams niṣ+ṭha sogs su slob phan las so/ /de rnams kṛta kyi rkyen yin pas snga ma'i dmigs bsal lo/ /de yang niṣ+ṭhā'i bhu dza skyong ba'i byings la/ k+ta dang k+ta wan+tu gnyis byin/ u brjod don/ tsa sde'i ki'o zhes pas dza kar bsgyur bas/ bhuk+ta dang bhuk+ta wan zhes pa lta bu tshig grogs gang dang lhan cig byung yang drug pa mi 'gyur bas/ de ba dat+te na bhuk+ta/ o da naṃ bhuk+ta wān lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du o daṃ naṃ pe tsi la/ kwan+su byin/ ka dang u rjes 'brel/ pe tsi wān yang snga ma bzhin no/ /de bzhin du o da na dang sbyar nas| pe tsi la/ kā na dang*/ shan+tṛng*/ ā na sha rnams byin/ rjes 'brel rnams kṛta nyid du 'chad pa bzhin phyis/ o da naṃ pe tsā naḥ o da naṃ pa tsan/ o da naṃ tsa pa mā na sogs te/ rgyas par slob phan dang*/ de'i 'grel bshad kho bo'i bla ma'i legs bshad du blta bar bya'o/ /de dag ni ming le dang por bshad pa'i rnam dbye rnams kyi dmigs bsal te/ rgyug shin tu che ba mang bas zhib tu bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la ṣaḍa'i dang*/ ma na'i dang ta sde'i dang sa yig dang*/ na yig rnams kyi lus 'gyur rnams so/ /de yang dang po gnyis pha rol gyi yi ge dang*| phyi ma gsum snga rol gyi yi ge la brten pa'i lus 'gyur yin no/ /dang po ni| rtags mtha'i ṣa dang*/ ḍa yig ni pha rol gyi na yig la ṇa ru 'gyur ba'/ོ/ ṣaṣ ām/ grangs las ṣaḍa'i mtha' las so zhes pas nu/ ha sha zhes pas ṣa'i ḍa'o/ /'dis na la ṇa'o/ /'og gi ta sde'i zhes pas na ṇa'o/ ṣaṇ+ṇāṃ/ gnyis pa ni ma na dag tshig mtha'i lus 'gyur mtshams sbyor du brjod zin pas/ tshig mtha' ma yin pa dag dhuṭa pha rol la rjes su nga ror 'gyur ba'o/ /kra mu rkang pa bskyod/ ra mu rtse/ u rjes 'brel/ s+ya te/ pha rol la mdo 'dis rjes su nga ro'o/ /kraṃ s+ya te| raṃ s+ya te/ sarbis/ dha nus/

ya shas rnams la dzas/ shi dhuṭa las nu/ nā mi dang zhes pas sa'i ṣa ste/ nā mtha'i u pa dhā ring po dang*/ 'dis na rjes su nga ror byas pas/ sarbiṃ ṣi/ dha nūṃ ṣi/ ya shāṃ si/ tshig mtha' ma yin pa'i ma dang na ni| sde pa pha rol la sde pa de'i mtha' mar 'gyur ba'o/ /sha mu dang da mu nye bar zhi| u brjod don/ 'gro ba'i don dang zhes sogs kyis k+ta/ lnga pa'i u pa dhā zhes sogs kyi ring po/ shān+ta/ dān+ta/ de bzhin du sha ki dogs/ wa ki 'khyog/ num 'byung 'gyur la/ zhes sogs kyi shwasta nī tā/ byings thams cad pa min pa zhes pas/ iṭa ā ga ma'o/ /shaṅki tā wiṅka tā/ gsum pa ni/ rtags kyi cha shas pha rol gyi ta sde'i nang tshan pha rol ni tshul rol gyi tsa dang ṭa'i sde pa dang sbyor bar byas pa na/ de gnyis la gang rung gcig tu 'gyur bas/ tsa ṭa'i sde pa dag go |dper na rā dzan/ ṭā/ wa ma brtsegs pa sogs kyis/ rā / 'dis rā dzñā| de bzhin du ṣaṣa/ ām nu/ ṣa ḍa'i na la ṇa/ 'dis/ ṣaṇ+ṇāṃ/ īḍa/ bstod/ te| an bi ka ra ṇa/ de ata sogs las 'jig sgra med pa rnams bal shiṭa min pa rnams kyi dang po'o/ /zhes pas ḍa'i ṭa/ 'dis ta'i ṭa/ iṭ+ṭe/ tshul rol pha rol dang sbyor na'ang 'gyur te/ bh+ras+dza smin pa la'o/ /ti an bi/ gra ha zhes sogs kyi saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas bh+ra'i ra yig ṛ/ dhuṭa zhes pas sa'i da/ 'dis da'ang dza/ bhṛdz+dza/ 'on kyang lji ba'i mdo'i byed pa las/ kha cig tu mi 'gyur te/ li ha ro myang*/ ma dhu sngon/ myang bar byed dos kwipa/ dngos po la tā twa dag go /ā khya ta las kyang ta ma sogs rnams so/ /zhes pas ta ma dang ta ra rnams sbyar/ ha sha sogs kyis ha ḍa/ sgra med pa la dang po'o/ /ma dhu li

/ ma dhu li / ma dhu/ li ma/ ma dhu li ra rnams te/ 'di rnams mdo 'dis bsgyur na/ de phan gy-i byed pa mi rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ dbyangs nā mi dang*/ gsal byed ka dang ra las/ pha rol de ma thag pa yin pa rkyen dang rnam 'gyur dang*| ā ga ma la gnas pa'i si yig ni ṣa yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste/ 'on kyang nu ā ga ma dang rnam par bcad pa dang*/ ṣa rnams gang rung bar na yod kyang 'gyur la/ med na yang ngo*/ /dper na nā mi las/ ag+ni ṣu/ wā yuṣu/ ka las wak+ṣu/ twa k+ṣu/ ra las/ gir+ṣu/ dhur+ṣu de rnams supa kyi rjes yin pas rkyen la gnas pa'o/ /e ṣaḥ lta bu ni/ rnam 'gyur la gnas pa ste e tata/ si/ t+yata sogs rnams kyi rnam dbye la a/ a yig la dbyi/ ta'i 'ang ngos/ sa 'dis ṣa/ si rnam bcad do/ /ye ṣāṃ lta bu ni ā ga ma la gnas pa ste/ yata/ ām/ thams cad las ām la su dhu ṭa mang po'o/ /pirwāṃ ṣi/ dha nuṃ ṣi/ lta bu ni nu bar na yod pa ste/ sarbis/ dha nus/ dzas shi dhu ṭa las nu/ dbyangs mthar byas pa'o/ /sarbiḥṣu/ dha nuḥṣu/ lta bu ni rnam bcad bar na yod pa ste/ de gnyis la sup'o/ /yang de gnyis kyi sa yig rkyen la gnas pa'i sa/ nā mi las ṣa ru bsgyur ba la/ sup byas na ṣa bar na yod par 'gyur bas/ sarbiṣ+ṣu sogs so// 'on kyang rkyen gyi sa la/ 'di'i ṣas ma khyab ste/ sāta kyi rkyen la ṣa mi 'dod pa'i phyir te/ ag+ni sā ta/ dha da dhi sāta/ ces slob phan las so/ /lnga pa ni/ ra dang ṣa dang*| ṛ'i yi ge ring thung gnyis rnams las pha rol gyi tshig mtha' min pa'i na'i ṇa ru bsgyur bar bya ste/ de ma thag pa yin na lta ci smos/ dbyangs dang ha dang ya dang wa dang ka sde dang pa sde bar na yod kyang 'gyur la/ dur sing las dbyangs yin pa'i phyir rnam bcad rjes su nga ro'o/ /rnam bcad kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ lce rtsa can dang*/ mchu can bar na yod kyang*/ 'gyur bar bshad cing dper brjod kyang mdzad do/

/dper na tsa tur+ṇāṃ dang*/ dha ra ṇi/ pu ru ṣe ṇa/ pi tṝ ṇāṃ/ mā tṝ ṇāṃ/ ar+hai ṇāṃ/ ār+ye ṇa/ sarbe ṇa/ arke ṇa/ mūr+khe ṇa/ dar+pe kha ṇa/ garge kha ṇa/ re phe ṇa/ dharme ṇa/ shwirge ṇa/ briṃ he ṇa/ u raྈྐེ ṇa/ u raྉྤ ṇa'o// gsum pa ni/ a yig mtha' can gyi rtags las/ bud med kyi rtags su byed pa la āpa rkyen du sbyin par bya'o/ /pa yig ni slob phan du/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i don to zhes bshad cing*/ bdag gi bla ma ni tsan+d+ra par/ ngī āp+ti ūng rnams las so zhes pa'i rtags don du bzhed do/ /dper brjod slob phan du/ de ba dat+tā yā/ sā| kā rnams dang*/ dur sing du/ a dzā/ e ḍa kā/ tsa ṭa kā/ a shwā mu ṣi kā rnams bshad la gsung rab rnams su/ pradzñā/ bi d+ya shra dhā/ mu trā/ pā ra mi tā/ sogs mang po zhig 'di nyid du bshad cing*/ de thams cad la 'di pa'i lugs kyis| shrad dhā'i ming 'dogs shing*/ de la brten pa'i rnam dbye'i lus 'gyur sogs te gsang sngags kun tu'ang rgyug shin tu che'o/ /nā da dang*/ swo pa/ slob phan du/ ma hā dang ki so ra/ dur sing du/ tha ma'i tshab tu sla ba añtsa dang*/ bā ha dang*| u dang*/ i dang*/ an+sa dang*/ an+ta dang ṛ dang sa khi dang na mtha' can gyi rtags rnams las bud med du byed pa la ī ring po rkyen du sbyin par bya'/ོ/ na dī ma hī/ ki so rī/ sla/ bī/ añtsa las ni/ dang por añtsu 'gro/ kwipa/ a nu ṣaṅga zhes pas dbyi/ pra dang pra ti sngon/ añtsi'i a dbyi ba dang*/ snga ma'i yang ring por byas pas/ prā tsī/ pra tā+-i tsī/ bā ha las ni/ s+thā las pra sngon/ nā mi sogs kyi sa'i ṣa/ ṣa dang ṭa sde las ta sde'i ṭa sde'o/ /nyer sgyur las ni āta las ḍa'o// praṣ+ṭha bā ha thob/ bā ha las kyang zhes pas biṇa/ ṇa rjes 'brel/ wā hi'i wa sgra'i au 'os/ praṣ+ṭhau hī/ rab gnas thob ma'o/ /u'i ni/ pa ṭu/ mṛ du la/ pa ṭ+wī mṛ dwī i'i ni/ dak+ṣī/ a ba dhū tī/

shak+tī/ an+sa'i ni/ bi dwān+sa dang*/ pe tsi wan+sa la/ ghuṭa ma yin pa'i dbyangs dang po la iṭa dang bcas pa'i zhes pas/ ba dang ba iṭa dang bcas pa u ru bsgyur nas/ a nu ṣaṅga phyis/ bi du ṣī/ pe tsu ṣī/ mkhas ma dang*/ 'tshod ma'o/ /an+ta'i n-i/ go man+ta dang*/ dha na wan+ta la/ a nu ṣaṅga phyis pas/ go ma tī/ dha na wa tī/ phyugs ldan ma dang*/ nor ldan ma'o/ /phyi ma dus 'khor du nor gyi blo gros mar bsgyur te ma dag go /ṛ'i ni/ kar+tṛ dang*/ har+tṛ la| mtshams sbyar bas kar+t+ṝ har+t+rī sa khi'i ni/ sa khī/ na mtha'i ni/ daṇ+ḍi na/ pad min/ ḍā kin/ yo gin/ swo la 'dis daṇ+ḍi nī/ yo gi nī sogs so/ /'di la slob phan las dmigs bsal ma bshad mod kyi/ dur sing du k+ti'i rkyen can las ni k+ti nyid bud med du byed pa'i rkyen yin pas/ i'i rkyen mi ster ba dang*/ pañtsan dang*/ sap+tan/ na mtha' yin kyang bud med kyi dngos po med pas/ i'i rkyen mi byed pa dang*/ shwa sṛ dang*/ du hi tṛ sogs ṛ mtha' yin kyang*/ ī mi ster bar| |si la ā ste si dbyi ba yang ngo zhes byed par bshad do/ /'o na nā da sogs ā yig mtha' can gyi rtags la 'di byin nas mtshams sbyar ram zhe na/ min te/ bud med du byas pa'i rkyen ī yig pha rol la/ rtags mtha'i a yig dbyi bar bya'o/ /de wa dang nā da la/ ī/ de wī/ na dī/ dang por bud med kyi rtags na dī sogs su yod kyang*/ ma ning gi rtags su byed pa la dbyangs mtha' thung ngur 'gyur te/ se nā nī/ ya wa lta bu la sde dpon dang nas ja (rnga)ba'i rigs zhes/ ma ning gi rtags su byas pas/ se nā ni ku laṃ/ ya wa lu ku laṃ/ der ma zad ma ning du byas pa na/ ai i dang*/ au u nyid du'ang 'gyur te/ gser dang gru bzang ba'i rigs la a ti rai dang*/ a ti nau la/ a ti ri ku laṃ/ a t-i nu ku laṃ lta bu'o/ /zhes pa ming bzhi par rkang pa bzhi pa byed pa can drug gi rkang pa'i rnam bshad rdzogs so//

// 'di yan dhin+thi rar zhib par bkod grub/ lnga pa tshig sdud kyi rkang pa 'chad pa ni/ spyir snga ma dang phyi ma dag gi don nye bar dmigs pa na tshig go zhes bshad pa ltar rnam dbye ti sogs si sogs gang rung gi mtha' can don ston byed du dmigs pa na/ yul lam phyogs la 'jug pa'i ku dang*/ gang la 'jug pa'i yaḥ zhes pa lta bu y-i ge gnyis 'dus pa tsam gyis kyang*/ smra ba'i tshig tu 'grub kyi chos mngon pa nas bshad pa ltar bum pa zhes pa lta bu don gyi ngo bo ston pa ming dang*/ bum pa'i kha dog ces pa don gyi khyad par ston pa tshig tu 'jog pa lta bu ni min no/ /de ltar na/ rang lugs kyi tshig gnyis sam/ mang po dag gi rnam dbye so so ba phyis te bsdus nas don gzhan khyad par ba ston byed du bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir du/ rtags su byas pa'i mthar rnam dbye'i nang nas si sogs byin nas/ tshig khyad par can du bsgrubs pa ni/ tshig bsdud kyi don yin te/ dpang lo chen pos/ tshig sdud phal cher supa kyis 'jig de ni ming rnams sbyar ba'i don*/ zhes gsungs so/ /de la dbye na/ smra sgo las/ du ma bshad kyang*/ sgra mdo gnyis las drug tu nges par bshad de/ 'dir las 'dzin gyi dang*/ ba gnyis pa'i dang*/ de'i skyes bu'i dang*/ 'bru mang po'i dang*/ zlas dbye'i dang*/ mi zad par gyur pa'i tshig sdud ces gsungs la/ tsan+d+ra par/ de drug la rim pa bzhin/ gzhi mthun gyi dang*/ grangs snga ma can gyi dang*| byed can drug pa'i dang*/ gzhan gyi don gyi dang*/ rang gi don gyi dang*/ grangs med pa'i tshig sdud ces gsungs so/ /de rnams kyis ngos 'dzin ni/ gzhung du 'og nas bshad par bya zhing*/ dpang los kyang*/ khyad par can dang khyad par tshig/gzhi 'thun sdud pa las 'dzin pa'am/ khyad par bsdu ba'i gcig pa'o/ /de nyid grangs dang bgrang bya na/ /ba gnyis pa'am grangs dang po// ming dang pha rol tshig gis ni/ /gnyis pa la sogs sdud pa de/

/byed can drug pa'i bsdu zhes bya/ /de gsum de yi skyes bur bshad/ /gang gi snga ma brjod byar 'gyur| |mi zad pa'am grangs med pa'o/ /tshig gnyis dag gam mang po rnams// gzhan gyi don na 'bru mang po 'am/ /gzhan gyi don zhes bya ba ste// phyogs kyi ming dag phyogs bral la'ang*/ /gzhan dang gzhan ni sbyor ba dang*/ kun sdud pa la ming gnyis sam/ /mang po'i bsdus pa zlas dbye'am/ /dang gi don gyis bsdu ba'o| |zhes gsungs pa'i ltar ro/ /de ltar na/ dang po gsum po mi 'gal zhing*| de yang snga ma gnyis gsum pa'i bye brag dang*/ gnyis pa yang dang po'i bye brag tu shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na/ rkang pa 'di la don bzhi ste/ tshig sdud kyi ngo bo dang*/ bsdu tshul dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rtags kyi ngos 'dzin no/ /dang po ni/ 'dir slob phan du/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis rtags rnam dbye'i mtha' can la ming du byas pa zhes bshad pa dang*/ dpang los kyang*/ rang bzhin byings dang ming zhes ming ni rnam dbye ster ba'i gzhi yin zhing don ldan gyi byings dang tshig ma gtogs/ ming yin zhes ming tshig 'gal bar bshad cing*/ byings dang rnam dbye bor ba'i don dang ldan pa rtags so/ /zhes rtags ni ming dang don gcig par bshad pas na/ 'dir ming rnams zhes pa ni/ rtags rnam dbye'i mtha' can du bshad pas/ tshig la ming du btags par shes par bya bas na/ phal cher si sogs kyi mtha' can gyi tshig re re ba rnams don gzhan ston pa'i phyir du gcig tu sbyor ba'i sgo nas don ston par byed pa ni/ tshig bsdu ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /bsdu ba'i ming bzhag pa'i don dgos pa ni/ bsdu ba'i mthar gyur pa zhes sogs kyi skabs su'o/ /dper na 'di sngon po dang 'di ud pa la zhes pa la/ nī laḥ tsa/ a yam/ ut+pa laḥtsa a yam/ de mtshams sbyar bas| nī lash+tsar yaṃ ut+pa lash+tsā ra yaṃ/ 'di nyid sngon po yang yin ud pa la yang yin zhes/

de yis de yi bsdu ba'o/ /der gnas rnam dbyi rnams dbyi bar bya'/ོ/ zhes pas/ sa'i rnam bcad dang*/ mi zad pa'i tsa dang*/ i daṃ gyi lus 'gyur a yam gnyis rnams bsdus pa'i mthar si byin/ mtshams sbyar bas nī lod pa laḥ de bzhin du rā dzan/ ngas/ rā dzñaḥ pu ru ṣaḥ bsdus pas/ rā dza pu ru ṣaḥ rgyal po'i skyes bu zhes te/ rgya skad la drug pa bsdus kyang*/ bod skad la sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa ni tshig sdud byas pa'i tshe/ bsdu bya der gnas pa'i rnam dbye rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /rā dzan/ ām/ pu ru ṣaḥ rā dzñāṃ pu ru ṣaḥ zhes gnas pa la/ 'dis rā dza pu ru ṣaḥ rtags mtha'i na phyis pa'o/ /rigs kyis duṃ bu la/ saṃ ku lā/ ṭā/ saṃ ku la yā khaṇ+ḍaṃ/ 'dis saṃ ku la khaṇ+ḍaṃ/ 'o na tshig sdud la dbyi bar 'os pa yin na/ rnam dbye kho na yin pa khyab bam zhe na/ ma khyab ste/ sngar i dam sogs kyi tshig gi phrad rnams kyang phyis pa bzhin du dbyi bar 'os pa gzhan yang rnam gzhag bshad pa las 'thob ste/ gang gi zhal lha'i zhal dang 'dra ba de zhes pa la/ ya s+ya de bo mu kha s+ya mu khash+tsai ba saḥ zhes pa'i rnam dbyer ma zad/ gzhi dang phrad dang*/ khyad par dang 'dra ba'i skad dod/ e ba/ bsdus pas/ de ba mu khaḥ de bzhin du mar gyis gang ba'i bum pa la/ ghṛ te na pur+ṇa s+ya gha ṭa/ 'di'i yang rnam dbyer ma zad gang ba'i ming yang bsdus te/ ghṛ ta gha ṭaḥ de bzhin du gang la sdig pa med pa de zhes pa'i/ yasmin/ bi d+ya ma naḥ pā paṃ saḥ 'di yang a pā paṃ/ zhes par bsdus pa ste/ bsdus rjes kyi tshig rnams kyis kyang*/ don ni zhal lha 'dra ba/ mar gyi bum pa/ sdig med ces pa rnams ston no/ kha cig tu rnam dbye dbyi bar mi 'gyur te/ gang gi mgrin pa la nag po yod pa de zhes| ya s+ya kan+ṭhe kā lo bi d+ya ma naḥ saḥ zhes pa bsdus pa'i/ kan+ṭhe kā laḥ de bzhin du brang la spu yod pa zhes pa la/ /ya s+ya u ra si lo mo bi d+ya ma naḥ saḥ bsdus pas/

u ra pi lo maḥ 'di gnyis ka la ngi ma bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin du āt+man gyi sgra las pha rol gyi gsum pa ni/ grangs las rdzogs pa'i rkyen la dbyi bar mi 'gyur te/ āt+ma nā pañtsa maḥ tshig sdud byas nas rnam dbye phyis pa na/ sngar rnam dbye'i bya ba byas pa de yang*/ phyir log nas dbyangs mtha' ni/ dang po'i rtags kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du'ang 'gyur te/ mā ta ri ni pu naḥ dang*| pi ta ri sā dhuḥ gnyis nge la ara'o zhes pa'i ngi bsdus pa na/ de'i bya ba yang bsdus nas/ mā tṛ ni pu naḥ pi tṛ sā dhuḥ zhes sogs so/ /bsdu bya'i rtags gsal byed mtha' can yin na'ang*/ rnam dbye phyis pa na sngar gyi rang bzhin du 'gyur la/ 'on kyang 'di la ni/ gang su bha dag ces pa/ rdzogs pa dang gsal byed dang po la bshad pa'i bya ba thams cad 'di la'ang 'gyur te/ bi dwan+sa/ ngas/ ar+tha/ wa sgra u/ a nu ṣaṅga phyis/ sa ṣa sa rnam bcad/ de u/ mtshams sbyar/ tshig mthar eta ota la sogs byas pas/ bi du ṣar+thoḥ bsdus pa na'ang wa sgra ur byas pa log kyang wan+sa'i sa da ru bsgyur ba dang*/ rtags mtha'i na dbyi ba byas pas/ bi dwa dar+thaḥ de bzhin du/ rā dzñor+thaḥl/ rā dzar+thaḥ dip la am/ di paṃ ga taḥ bsdus pa na/ ga pha rol la/ dip kyi gsal byed la uta'o/ /byas pas| dhu ga taḥ gsum pa la las 'dzin gyi dang*/ ba gnyis pa'i dang*/ de'i skyes bu dang*/ 'bru mang po'i dang*/ zlas dbye'i dang*/ mi zad par gyur pa'i tshig sdud bshad pa'o*/ /dang po ni tshig sdud gang du/ tshig gnyis kyi brjod bya gzhi mthun pa'i sgo nas ngo bo gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshig gnyis dag gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshig sdud de ni las 'dzin byed pa zhes bya ba'i tshig sdud du rnam par shes par bya ste/ 'di bram ze dang 'di bu mo zhes pa la/ brāh+ma ṇā tse yaṃ dā ri kā tse yaṃ zhes gnas pa de yis de yi bsdu ba'o/ /zhes bsdus/ der gnas rnam dbye'i tshig phrad dang bcas pa phyir/

brāh+ma ṇa dā ri kā zhes bram ze yang yin bu mo yang yin pas bram ze'i bu mo zhes pa'o/ /'o na brā h+ma ṇa zhes pa'i ṇa'i shrad dhā phyis pa ci zhe na/ las 'dzin byed pa'i ming la ni/ skyes pa dang 'dra'i dngos bsgrub bya/ zhes pas so/ /de bzhin du/ sngar bshad pa bzhin nī lot+pa laṃ zhes so/ /'di khrus dang 'di phyi ba zhes pa la/ snā tā tse yaṃ/ a nu lip+tāsh+tsā yaṃ zhes pa bsdus pas/ snā tā nu lip+taḥ dril phyis zhes pa'o/ /dur sing du sbrul nag po la/ kṛṣ+ṇa sarba zhes sogs shin tu mang po bshad do/ / gnyis pa ni de nyid grangs dang bgrang bya na zhes dang*/ dur sing du/ ba gnyis pa'i las 'dzin zhes snga ma'i bye brag tu gsungs pas/ brjod bya gzhi mthun gyi nang mtshan gang zhig /grangs snga ma can gyi tshig sdud ni/ grangs dang bgrang bya'i tshig gnyis bsdus pas na/ ba gnyis pa zhes pa'i tshig sdud du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i skad dod du dwi gaḥ zhes pa yod pas/ ba lang gi ba gnyis pa zhes pa yin gyi pa dang ba zhes sogs tshig phrad du 'dod pa ni cha med kyi rgyus gtam mo/ /'on kyang rgyu mtshan bshad du yod par ni ma mthong ngo*/ /de la dbye na/ de phan gyi dang*/ tshogs pa'i dang tshig phyi ma'i don can gyi ba gnyis pa gsum bshad do/ /dang po ni/ lnga yang yin la/ thod pa yang yin pa'i don la/ pañtsa ka pā laḥ 'di ltar sogs kyi a ṇar 'dod/ ces pas de phan gyi aṇa ba gnyis pa la/ de phan 'jig par tsan+d+ra par bshad pa'i 'jig rten pa'i nyer spyod byas/ tshogs pa'i don la/ chu klung lnga tshogs pa la/ pañtsa nā di/ ba glang lnga tshogs pa la/ pañtsa go de'i 'di zhes pas aṇa i'i yi ge dang zhes pas i dbyi ba dang*/ o a wa byas/ 'phel ba ma byas shing*/ de bzhin ba gnyis zhes pas/ ma ning yin pa la si mu byas pas/ pañtsa nā dam/ pañtsa ga wam/ tshig phyi ma can ni/ bram ze lnga dang grong bcu la/ pañtsa brā h+ma ṇī/ da sha gra mī/ slob phan gyi ming rkang bdun par/

ba gnyis pa las ī'ā+-i rkyen bshad pa byin/ i'i zhes sogs kyi a phyis pa'o/ /de'i skyes bu gnyis zhes pa ni/ tshig sdud drug gi nang nas gzhi 'thun dang ba gnyis pa de gnyis po de'i skyes bu'i bsdu bar 'du ba yin no/ /zhes pa yin pas/ /dper brjod zur pa mi dgos so/ /

gsum pa ni/ tshig sdud gang du gnyis pa la sogs pa'i rnam dbye'i mtha' rnams/ ming dang pha rol gyi tshig dang bcas pa dag gis ni sdud par byed pa'i sgo nas tshig gcig tu gyur pa de yang*/ de'i skyes bu bsdu ba zhes pa'i ming can yin par shes par bya'o/ 'di la gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi bsdu ba yod pas dang po gnyis la bsdus pa ni/ chos la brten zhes pa bsdus nas chos rten zhes zer na/ dharmaṃ shri taḥl/ dharma shri taḥ gsum la bsdus pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis bskyangs pa la/ sangs rgyas bskyangs ni/ bud dhe na pā li tā la bud pā li ta/ bzhi pa bsdus na/ mchog gi phyir sbyor ba la/ mchog sbyor ba ni/ ba rā ya yu dzi la/ lnga pa bsdus na/ chos las 'byung ba la chos 'byung ni/ dharmāta saṃ bha waḥl/ dharma saṃ bha waḥ drug pa bsdus na chos kyi sgo la| chos sgo ni dharma s+ya mu khaḥ la| dharma mu khaḥ bdun pa bsdus pa ni chos la gnas pa la chos gnas ni dharme s+thī ta la/ dharma s+thī ta/ de bzhin du mig rnams la ling thog ces pa bsdu na/ ak+ṣe ṣu paṇ+ḍo la/ ak+ṣa paṇ+ḍoḥ 'gram na bya rog la/ tīr+the kā kaḥ la/ tīr+tha kā kaḥ zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gal te tshig sdud gang du tshig gnyis dag gcig tu bsdus nas/ don gzhan ston pa'i tshig gcig tu gyur taṃ/ gal te tshig mang por gyur pa'ang rung ste/ tshig mang po de rnams gcig tu bsdus na/ brjod bya snga ma las don gzhan ston pa'i tshig gcig tu gyur pa la ni| 'bru mang po pa'i tshig sdud ces bya ste/ dper na gang dbyug pa dang*/ dbyug pas 'thab pa de zhes pa dbyug 'thab ces gcig tu bsdu nas/ yo daṇ+ḍash+tsa daṇ+ḍe na yu dhaḥ saḥ la/ daṇ+ḍa/ daṇ+ḍi bsdu ba'i mthar gyur pa zhes pas/ i'i rkyen dang*/ snga ma la ma hata kyi/ ī'i yi ger byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du gang bu dang bcas pas 'jug pa de bu bcas ces bsdus na yaḥ sa pu traḥ wartaḥ saḥl si pu traḥ gang chung ma dang bcas pas 'tsho ba de zhes pa/

khyo shug ces par bsdu na/ yaḥ sa| bhār+ya rak+ṣi taḥ saḥl/ bhār+ya rak+ṣi taḥ saḥ la sa bhār+ya/ de bzhin du gang la ba glang khra bo yod pa de ba glang khra bo can zhes bsdu na/ ye tse tra goḥ saḥ laḥ tsitra guḥ ma ning la zhes par gzhan la'ang*/ dbyangs thung ngu zhes pas o'i u'/ོ/ de bzhin du lha gang gi phyag na nor bu dang pad+ma yod pa de nor bu pad ma can zhes bsdu na/ ya s+ya de waḥ pā ṇau ma ṇiḥ pad+ma sh+tsa bi d+ya ma naḥ saḥ la/ ma ṇi pad maḥ de bzhin du rigs bsgre'o/ /tshig mang po bsdus pa ni/ nyi ma'i 'od zer yongs su 'phros pa'i pad+ma rnams rdzing bu'i chu gang na yod pa de zhes pa/ ra wiḥ ki ra ṇaḥ pa ri ka ro bi ka si to na li n+yaḥ puska ra s+ya wā naṃ yasmin bi d+ya ma na saḥ zhes pa de/ puska ra s+ya dang*/ ya smin man chad dang rnam dbye rnams bsdus pa lta bu'/ོ/ de bzhin du dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsrungs ma drug cu'i bcu tshan/ re re'i ming so so'i rnam dbye rnams bsdus/ tshig gcig tu byas nas kun gyi mthar/ bh+yas byin pa lta bu ste mang ngo*/ /gzhan yang phyogs bral zhes pa phyogs kyi bar mtshams rnams brjod par 'dod nas/ phyogs gnyis kyi ming gcig tu bsdus na'ang snga ma de bzhin du 'bru mang po par 'gyur te/ dper na/ lho dang shar zhes pa'i dak+ṣi ṇa tsa/ pūrwā tsa zhes pa bsdus pas/ dak+ṣi ṇā pūrba/ shar dang byang gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ pūrba tsa/ ut+ta rā tsa la/ purbot+ta ra de gnyis rim pa bzhin phyogs so so'i ming bsdus pas phyogs mtshams shar lho'am me dang*/ byang shar ram dbang ldan zhes pa yin la/ bsdus pa snga ma'i dbyangs thung ngur song ba ni/ skyes pa can bshad pa zhes sogs kyi skyes pa bzhin byas pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ tshig sdud gang du/ 'di dang 'di zhes pa'i ming gnyis dag gam ming mang po bsdus pa'ang ste gzhi tha dad pa gang zhigatshig gcig tu bsdus pa de zlas dbye'i tshig sdud du 'gyur te/ zla bos dbye zhes pa'i de la yang dbye na/

gzhan dang gzhan sbyor ba dang*/ kun sdud pa'i zlas dbye gnyis so/ /de gnyis kyang rim pa bzhin yan lag gtso bor byas pa dang*/ tshogs pa gtso bor byas pa'o/ /dang po ni na rash+tsa nā rā ya ṇash+tsa/ sha krash+tsa/ bṛ haspa/ ti sh+tsa/ de gnyis bsdus pas na ra nā ra ya ṇau sha kra bṛ haspa/ tī/ gnyis ka la au byin pa'o/ /bhī mash+tsārdzu nash+tsa bā su de bash+tsa ces pa la/ bhī mārdzu na bā su de bāḥdzas byin pa'o/ /dper brjod de gsum ni rim bzhin/ mi dang mi'i bu brgyud/ brgya byin dang lha bdag 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs sde dang*/ srid sgrub dang nor lha'i bu/ zhes pa rnams te/ tshig sdud 'di'i tshig mthar/ rnam dbye gnyis tshig dang*/ mang tshig gang rung tu nges kyi gcig tshig mi srid cing*/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba bye brag pa dang po gnyis la rnam dbye dang po srid/ de las gzhan spyi 'gro la dang po mi srid/ 'bru mang phal cher dang po'i gcig tshig gi mtha' can no/ /gnyis pa ni yan lag gtso bo'i zlas dbye la gzhan dang*/ gzhan sbyor bas ma khyab ste/ srog chags kyi yan lag rkang lag lta bu dang*/ rol mo'i yan lag rnga zlum dang pheg rdeb lta bu dang*/ dpung gi yan lag shing rta dang*| rta pa zhes pa rnams kun sdud kyi zlas dbye yin pa'i phyir te/ pā ṇish+tsa pā dash+tsa la/ pā ṇi pā daṃ/ mārdaṃ gi kash+tsa pā na bi kash+tsa la/ mārdaṃ gi ka pā ṇa bi kaṃ ra thi kash+tsa/ ashwā ro/ hash+tsa la/ ra thi kā shwā ro haṃ/ tshogs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dngos po ni/ rgya shug dang skyu ru ra zhes pa/ ba da dash+tsa ma la kash+tsa la/ ba ra da ma la kaṃ lta bu'o/ /srog chags phra mo rnams kyi tshogs pa ni shig dang sro ma/ sbrang bu dang*/ sha sbrang*/ sbrul dang ne'u le rnams la/ yū ka tsa lik+ṣaḥ daṃ shash+tsa ma ṣa ka a hash+tsa na ku laḥ rnams bsdus te yū ka li k+ṣaṃ/ daṃ sha ma ṣa kaṃ a ha na ku laṃ lta bu'o// ljon pa dang ri dwags dang*/ rtswa dang*/ 'bru dang bya na dang phyugs dang*/

bya rnams brjod pa'i zlas dbye ni kun sdud de/ 'di gzhan dang gzhan sbyor bar yang bshad do/ /de rnams dper na p+lak+ṣash+tsa n+ya gro dhaḥ ha ri ṇash+tsa ba rā haḥ ku shash+tsa kā shaḥ ya bash+tsa mā ṣaḥ da dhish+tsa gh+ri taḥ gaush+tsa ma hi ṣaḥ haṃ sash+tsaḥ tsa kra wākaḥ rnams rim bzhin p+lak+ṣa dang*/ n+ya gro dha seng ge dang phagaku sha dang ka sha nas dang*/ sran ma/ zho dang mar/ ba glang*/ ma he/ ngang pa dang*/ ngur pa zhes bya la/ de thams cad kyi mi zad pa'i tsa rnams bsdus/ de bzhin ba gnyis zhes pas/ kun bsdus kyi phyogs la/ ma ning gi si mu bya/ gzhan dang gzhan sbyor ba'i phyogs la/ thams cad la au byin/ p+lak+ṣa n+ya gro dhau/ zhes sogs bya| zho mar la/ ma ning la au ī bya'o/ /de bzhin du zlas dbye gnyis kyi sbyor ba mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas gzhan kun la yang shes par bya'o/ /zhes mkhas pa grag 'byor gyis bshad la/ dur sing las/ dper brjod rgyas pa 'di lta bu ma bshad do/ /'o na zlas dbye'i bsdu bya gnyis po tshig gang zin go rim nges med du bsdus pas chog gam snyam na/ mi chog ste zlas dbye'i tshig sdud der yang gnyis po'i dbyangs gang rab tu nyung ba de snga mar sbyar bar bya ste/ de gnyis kyi nang nas brjod bya gang zhig mchod par 'os pa de yang snga mar sbyar bar bya'o// 'di la sngon gyi 'gyur rnams las/ dang po gnyis te mchod 'os sam/ /yang na yi ge rab nyung ba'o/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dper na bud dha bo dhis sa twa lta bu la gnyis ka tshang ngo*/ /drug pa ni/ tshig sdud gang gi tshig snga ma de sgra'i ngo bo mi zad pa yin zhing*/ de nyid brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i tshig sdud de ni mi zad par gyur pa zhig tu 'dod pa yin no/ /dper na bsnyen rdzogs kyi ming u pa sa māp+ta zhes pa'i u pa ni nye ba/ sa māp+ta ni rdzogs pa yin la/ de'i rdzogs pa ni myang 'das yin kyang*/ der brjod bya de'i gtso bo min te/ dge slong gi sdom pa brjod bya'i gtso bo yin la/

de myang 'das min gyi/ de dang nye ba'i lam yin pas| snga ma nye ba de brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du u pa kum+bha zhes pa'i nye ba'i bum pa yang*/ bum pa dngos brjod bya'i gtso bo ma yin gyi/ de dang 'dra ba'am nye ba'i snod gzhan zhig gtso bor brjod pa dang*/ pra ti mok+ṣa zhes pa'i so sor thar pa yang thar pa brjod bya'i gtso bo ma yin gyi de'i rgyu'am thabs so so ba'am dang po zhes pa sdom pa brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa sogs shin tu mang la/ 'grel pa gnyis su dper brjod mang du mdzad pa rnams kyang don gcig la/ 'on kyang slob phan du/ sdig med la a pā paṃ dang nus pa ji lta ba la/ ya thā shak+ki sogs dang*/ dur sing du/ gā ba dī kā naṃ/ tatwā ṇa ni sogs tshig snga ma mi zad pa min pa'i dper brjod kyang bshad pas/ gzhung don gyi bshad pa 'di lo tsā nam bzang pa dang*/ bdag gi bla mas mdzad mod kyi gtso che ba'i dbang du byas par byed dgos par rtogs so/ /bzhi pa la tshig sdud dngos kyi rtags dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i rtags bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshig sdud drug pa mi zad pa'i tshig sdud de ni rtags gsum gyi nang nas ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur bas/ ming le gnyis par ma ning gi rtags la gang bshad kyi si mu la sogs pa'ang thob mod kyi 'on kyang ming ler bzhi par mi zad par 'gyur pa las ces sogs kyi skabs su bshad pa thams cad de bzhin dang ma bshad pa thams cad gong gi bzhin bya'o/ /tshig sdud gzhan la ma ning gi rtags med dam snyam na/ yod de/ zlas dbye gnyis las gcig kun sdud pa dang*/ de bzhin du ba gnyis pa'i nang nas kyang kun sdus pa rnams kyang ma ning kho nar nges pas ma ning gi rtags la gang bshad sbyar bar bya'o/ /de gnyis dper na/ pā ṇi pā daṃ/ pañtsa ga waṃ zhes sogs so/ /'on kyang slob phan du tshig snga ma la ni/ ma ning la dbyangs thung ngu'o zhes sogs nges kyang*/

ba gnyis pa la a yig mtha' can gyi tshig phyi ma mo rtags su bshad pa'ang yod de/ pañtsa brāh+ma ṇī da sha puṣ+pī sogs so// ma bshad pa'i tshig sdud lhag ma rnams la ma ning gi rtags med do zhes bya ba ni shugs las grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang zhar byung ngo*/ /dang po la pho rtags bshad pa dang*| mo rtags bshad pa'o/ /dang po la spyir btang ba ni/ da lta bud med brjod na/ mo rtags su byed par nges sam zhe na/ ma yin te/ sgra gang la tshul gang gis sngar skyes pa'i rtags can du bshad pa da ltar bud med la 'jug bzhin pa'i sgra 'ga' zhig ni/ bud med kyi rkyen ma byin par skyes pa bzhin du byed pa yod de/ de yang gzhi mthun pa'i tshig sdud yod pa dang*/ ūng gi rkyen can ma yin zhing*/ 'og gi grangs las rdzogs pa la ḍa ma dag ces sogs rdzogs pa la sogs pa'i mo rtags kyi rkyen gyi mtha' can min pa la de ltar mi byed pas so// rdzogs pa sogs kyi sgras ni/ pri yā dang*/ ma no dzñā dang*/ ka l+yā ṇi dang*| su bha gā dang*/ dur bha gā dang*/ shā mī dang*/ tsa pa ā dang*/ swā dang sa tsi wā dang*/ kan+tā dang*/ bhag+tī rnams bzung bar slob phan las so/ /dper na sū gu dang*/ gzugs mdzes pa dang*/ dge ma'am/ btsun mo dang*/ gzhi mthun brjod pa| dar+sha nī yaḥ bhār+ya/ su rū pa bhār+ya/ ka l+yā ṇa bhar+ya rnams kyi tshig snga phyi kun mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/ka lā pa'i rnam par bshad pa legs sbyar snang ba'i sgron me/ -PAGE 88--PAGE 101- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
